summary.zh-CN: 古埃及第四王朝开始建造吉萨大金字塔群
summary.en-US: Egypt's Fourth Dynasty began constructing the Giza pyramid complex.

body.zh-CN: 古埃及第四王朝开始建造吉萨大金字塔群
body.en-US: Around 2580 BCE, Old Kingdom builders raised monumental tombs at Giza. The pyramids became enduring symbols of pharaonic power and Egyptian cosmology.

events.review_note: 吉萨大金字塔建造年代存疑；古埃及归入非洲文明

quote.zh-CN: 吉萨金字塔矗立至今，是人类早期文明的永恒坐标。
quote.en-US: The Giza pyramids still stand—a timeless marker of early civilization.

title.en-US: Indus Valley Civilization at Its Height

summary.zh-CN: 哈拉帕和摩亨佐-达罗等城市繁荣，印度河流域文明进入全盛期
summary.en-US: Cities such as Harappa and Mohenjo-daro flourished as the Indus Valley civilization reached its peak.

body.zh-CN: 哈拉帕和摩亨佐-达罗等城市繁荣，印度河流域文明进入全盛期
body.en-US: Urban centers like Harappa and Mohenjo-daro supported planned streets, drainage, and standardized weights. The civilization's script remains undeciphered, but its material culture marks a major Bronze Age achievement in South Asia.

sources: Archaeological reports on Harappa and Mohenjo-daro

quote.zh-CN: 摩亨佐-达罗的街道与排水，印欧文明最早的都市奇迹。
quote.en-US: Mohenjo-daro’s streets and drains—an early urban marvel of the Indus.

title.en-US: Yu the Great Tames the Floods

summary.zh-CN: 传说中大禹治理黄河洪水。夏朝以前史实尚待考古证实。
summary.en-US: Tradition credits Yu with controlling Yellow River floods; pre-Xia history awaits archaeological confirmation.

body.zh-CN: 传说中大禹治理黄河洪水。夏朝以前史实尚待考古证实。
body.en-US: Classical Chinese narrative places Yu's flood-control labors before the Xia dynasty. Modern scholars treat the story as foundational myth that may preserve distant memories of hydraulic crisis and early state formation.

quote.zh-CN: 治水导川，疏而不堵——大禹传说奠定了中华治水的文化原型。
quote.en-US: Channel the waters, do not merely block them—Yu's legend shaped China's archetype of flood control.

summary.zh-CN: 传统认为禹之子启建立夏朝。考古学界对夏朝年代与性质仍有争议。
summary.en-US: Tradition holds that Yu's son Qi founded the Xia; archaeologists still debate Xia chronology and identity.

body.zh-CN: 传统认为禹之子启建立夏朝。考古学界对夏朝年代与性质仍有争议。
body.en-US: Traditional chronology names Qi as the first hereditary ruler after Yu. Erlitou and related sites are often discussed as possible Xia material culture, but the linkage remains contested.

alt.zh-CN: 二里头青铜器（夏文化代表）

quote.zh-CN: 从禅让到世袭，夏朝传说标志着王权传承方式的转折。
quote.en-US: From abdication to hereditary rule—the Xia legend marks a turn in how kingship passed.

summary.zh-CN: 巴比伦国王汉谟拉比颁布法典，世界上现存较早的成文法典之一。
summary.en-US: King Hammurabi of Babylon issued one of the earliest surviving written law codes.

body.zh-CN: 汉谟拉比法典以「以眼还眼」著称，系统规范巴比伦社会的商业、家庭与刑罚，是美索不达米亚法治传统的重要里程碑。
body.en-US: The Code of Hammurabi regulated commerce, family, and punishment in Babylon and became a landmark of Mesopotamian legal tradition.

quote.zh-CN: 以眼还眼，以牙还牙——成文法第一次刻进石头。
quote.en-US: An eye for an eye—written law carved into stone for the first time.

summary.zh-CN: 商汤击败夏桀，建立商朝。考古学上商代晚期以前纪年仍有一定不确定性。
summary.en-US: King Tang defeated Jie of Xia and founded the Shang dynasty; pre-late-Shang chronology retains uncertainty.

body.zh-CN: 商汤击败夏桀，建立商朝。考古学上商代晚期以前纪年仍有一定不确定性。
body.en-US: Shang tradition credits Tang with ending Xia rule and establishing the Shang polity. Archaeological Shang evidence is secure for the late period, while earlier Shang dates remain under discussion.

quote.zh-CN: 商汤革命，中国第一个有直接文献与考古互证的王朝更替。
quote.en-US: King Tang’s revolution—China’s first dynastic change backed by text and archaeology.

summary.zh-CN: 克里特岛的米诺斯文明进入全盛期，克诺索斯宫殿建成
summary.en-US: Minoan Crete entered its golden age, with the palace complex at Knossos among its landmarks.

body.zh-CN: 克里特岛的米诺斯文明进入全盛期，克诺索斯宫殿建成
body.en-US: On Bronze Age Crete, Minoan palaces, frescoes, and maritime trade networks reached high sophistication. Knossos became a symbol of Aegean court culture before Mycenaean ascendancy.

quote.zh-CN: 克诺索斯的迷宫与公牛，爱琴海青铜文明的巅峰记忆。
quote.en-US: Knossos's labyrinth and bulls—peak memory of Aegean Bronze Age civilization.

title.zh-CN: 雅利安人进入印度次大陆
title.en-US: Indo-Aryan Arrival in the Indian Subcontinent

summary.zh-CN: 印欧语族群进入印度次大陆，吠陀文化逐渐形成。学界对“入侵”与“迁移”及年代仍有争论。
summary.en-US: Indo-European-speaking groups entered the subcontinent; scholars debate migration versus invasion and exact dating.

body.zh-CN: 印欧语族群进入印度次大陆，吠陀文化逐渐形成。学界对“入侵”与“迁移”及年代仍有争论。
body.en-US: Linguistic and Vedic evidence points to the spread of Indo-Aryan culture across northwestern India. Whether this was gradual migration or violent conquest, and how it relates to the decline of Indus cities, remains actively debated.

quote.zh-CN: 印欧语族南来，吠陀时代在南亚次大陆缓缓开启。
quote.en-US: Indo-European peoples arrived—the Vedic age slowly opened in South Asia.

summary.zh-CN: 盘庚迁都至殷（今安阳），甲骨文记载渐趋丰富
summary.en-US: King Pangeng relocated the Shang capital to Yin (Anyang), where oracle-bone records later flourished.

body.zh-CN: 盘庚迁都至殷（今安阳），甲骨文记载渐趋丰富
body.en-US: Around 1300 BCE, King Pangeng moved the Shang capital to Yin. The Anyang excavations later uncovered rich oracle-bone inscriptions that illuminate late Shang politics and ritual.

quote.zh-CN: 盘庚迁殷，商朝政治中心稳定，甲骨文文明进入成熟期。
quote.en-US: Pan Geng moved to Yin—the Shang matured into the oracle-bone age.

summary.zh-CN: 埃及法老拉美西斯二世与赫梯帝国在卡迭石大战，后签史上最早和平条约之一。
summary.en-US: Ramesses II fought the Hittites at Kadesh; one of history's earliest peace treaties followed.

body.zh-CN: 埃及法老拉美西斯二世与赫梯帝国在卡迭石大战，后签史上最早和平条约之一。
body.en-US: Ramesses II fought the Hittites at Kadesh; one of history's earliest peace treaties followed.

quote.zh-CN: 两大帝国在叙利亚平原对峙，和平条约比胜利更长久。
quote.en-US: Two empires clashed in Syria—the peace treaty outlasted victory.

summary.zh-CN: 据《圣经》记载，摩西带领以色列人离开埃及。属宗教文献记载，考古尚无共识。
summary.en-US: The Bible records Moses leading Israel out of Egypt; archaeology has not reached consensus on historicity.

body.zh-CN: 据《圣经》记载，摩西带领以色列人离开埃及。属宗教文献记载，考古尚无共识。
body.en-US: Biblical narrative places Moses at the center of Israel's departure from Egypt and the Sinai journey. The event is foundational for Judaism and later traditions, though extrabiblical confirmation remains elusive.

quote.zh-CN: 出埃及记——一部宗教经典，也是西方文明源头的叙事之一。
quote.en-US: The Exodus—a sacred narrative and one of the West's founding stories.

summary.zh-CN: 希腊史诗《伊利亚特》所叙之特洛伊战争。传说成分较重，遗址与年代仍存学术讨论。
summary.en-US: The legendary war at Troy recounted in the Iliad; archaeology and chronology remain debated.

body.zh-CN: 希腊史诗《伊利亚特》所叙之特洛伊战争。传说成分较重，遗址与年代仍存学术讨论。
body.en-US: Homeric epic places a Greek siege of Troy around the late Bronze Age. Excavations at Hisarlik and Hittite texts fuel discussion, but the war remains part legend, part historical problem.

quote.zh-CN: 特洛伊的城墙与荷马的史诗，连接考古与传说的永恒谜题。
quote.en-US: Troy's walls and Homer's epic—an eternal puzzle linking archaeology and legend.

summary.zh-CN: 中美洲奥尔梅克文明进入全盛，巨型石雕与贸易网络影响后来的玛雅文明。
summary.en-US: The Olmec civilization peaked in Mesoamerica, influencing later Maya culture.

body.zh-CN: 中美洲奥尔梅克文明进入全盛，巨型石雕与贸易网络影响后来的玛雅文明。
body.en-US: The Olmec civilization peaked in Mesoamerica, influencing later Maya culture.

quote.zh-CN: 中美洲文明的「母文化」在丛林与河流间留下巨石头像。
quote.en-US: Mesoamerica's "mother culture" left colossal heads in jungle and river valleys.

summary.zh-CN: 东地中海多个文明同时衰落，城市毁灭、贸易中断，原因至今存争议。
summary.en-US: Civilizations across the Eastern Mediterranean collapsed amid destroyed cities and broken trade.

body.zh-CN: 东地中海多个文明同时衰落，城市毁灭、贸易中断，原因至今存争议。
body.en-US: Civilizations across the Eastern Mediterranean collapsed amid destroyed cities and broken trade.

events.review_note: 年代与成因学界仍有多种假说

quote.zh-CN: 一夜之间，许多青铜时代的宫殿与文字一同消失。
quote.en-US: Almost overnight, Bronze Age palaces and scripts vanished.

alt.zh-CN: 海上民族入侵（青铜时代崩溃背景）

title.en-US: Battle of Muye · Zhou Overthrows Shang

summary.zh-CN: 周武王在牧野击败商纣王，商朝覆灭，西周建立。年代采用考古学界常用的公元前1046年说。
summary.en-US: King Wu of Zhou defeated Shang at Muye; archaeology often dates the event to c. 1046 BCE.

body.zh-CN: 周武王在牧野击败商纣王，商朝覆灭，西周建立。年代采用考古学界常用的公元前1046年说。
body.en-US: At Muye, Zhou forces under King Wu defeated the Shang army of King Zhou. The victory ended Shang rule and inaugurated the Western Zhou, a foundational turn in early Chinese political order.

events.review_note: 合并原 id 11（武王伐纣）与 id 12（牧野之战）重复条目

quote.zh-CN: 牧野之战，周武王革商命，礼乐文明的新章开启。
quote.en-US: At Muye, King Wu overthrew the Shang— a new chapter of ritual civilization began.

summary.zh-CN: 以色列联合王国大卫王攻占耶路撒冷，定为首都
summary.en-US: King David captured Jerusalem and made it the capital of the united Israelite kingdom.

body.zh-CN: 以色列联合王国大卫王攻占耶路撒冷，定为首都
body.en-US: Biblical tradition credits David with taking Jerusalem and establishing it as royal and cultic center. The city's later sacred status for Judaism, Christianity, and Islam traces back to this tradition.

quote.zh-CN: 大卫定都耶路撒冷，犹太—基督教传统中的政治与宗教中心由此确立。
quote.en-US: David made Jerusalem capital—the political and religious center of Judeo-Christian tradition.

summary.zh-CN: 周厉王被驱逐，中国历史从此有了确切纪年
summary.en-US: King Li of Zhou was driven out; Chinese history from 841 BCE onward has firm chronology.

body.zh-CN: 周厉王被驱逐，中国历史从此有了确切纪年
body.en-US: The expulsion of King Li ended a crisis of royal excess and inaugurated the Gonghe regency. From 841 BCE Chinese traditional chronology provides consecutive dating, a milestone in East Asian historiography.

quote.zh-CN: 国人暴动后，中国历史有了确切纪年的起点。
quote.en-US: After the capital uprising, Chinese history gained a firm chronological anchor.

title.zh-CN: 第一届奥林匹克运动会

summary.zh-CN: 古希腊第一届奥运会在奥林匹亚举行
summary.en-US: Traditional dating places the first Olympic Games at Olympia in 776 BCE.

body.zh-CN: 古希腊第一届奥运会在奥林匹亚举行
body.en-US: According to later Greek chronographers, athletic contests at Olympia began in 776 BCE. The games became a pan-Hellenic festival and a shared cultural calendar across city-states.

quote.zh-CN: 在奥林匹亚，城邦以竞赛而非战争彼此丈量。
quote.en-US: At Olympia, city-states measured themselves through games rather than war.

summary.zh-CN: 周平王迁都洛邑，东周开始，春秋时代序幕拉开。
summary.en-US: King Ping moved the capital to Luoyang, beginning the Eastern Zhou and Spring and Autumn era.

body.zh-CN: 周平王迁都洛邑，东周开始，春秋时代序幕拉开。
body.en-US: King Ping moved the capital to Luoyang, beginning the Eastern Zhou and Spring and Autumn era.

quote.zh-CN: 天子东迁，礼乐秩序松动，诸侯争霸的时代来临。
quote.en-US: The Son of Heaven moved east—ritual order loosened and lordly rivalry began.

summary.zh-CN: 罗马传统纪年认为罗慕路斯于此年建城，属传说时代史料。
summary.en-US: Roman tradition dated the city's founding by Romulus to 753 BCE.

body.zh-CN: 罗马传统纪年认为罗慕路斯于此年建城，属传说时代史料。
body.en-US: Livy and other writers place Rome's foundation in 753 BCE under Romulus. The date is legendary, yet it remained the epoch of the Roman calendar and civic identity.

alt.zh-CN: 卡比托利欧母狼（罗马建城象征）
alt.en-US: Capitoline Wolf, symbol of Rome's founding

quote.zh-CN: 母狼哺育的双子，罗马建城神话承载了一个帝国对自身起源的想象。
quote.en-US: Wolf-suckled twins—Rome's founding myth carried an empire's image of its origins.

title.en-US: Kingdom of Kush at Its Height

summary.zh-CN: 努比亚库施王国统治埃及（第二十五王朝）并控制尼罗河上游贸易。
summary.en-US: Kush ruled Egypt (25th Dynasty) and controlled Upper Nile trade routes.

body.zh-CN: 努比亚库施王国统治埃及（第二十五王朝）并控制尼罗河上游贸易。
body.en-US: Kush ruled Egypt (25th Dynasty) and controlled Upper Nile trade routes.

quote.zh-CN: 金字塔不只属于北方——努比亚法老改写了尼罗河的历史叙事。
quote.en-US: Pyramids were not only in the north—Nubian pharaohs rewrote Nile history.

summary.zh-CN: 米底与巴比伦联军攻陷 Nineveh，新亚述帝国终结。
summary.en-US: Medes and Babylonians captured Nineveh, ending the Neo-Assyrian Empire.

body.zh-CN: 米底与巴比伦联军攻陷 Nineveh，新亚述帝国终结。
body.en-US: Medes and Babylonians captured Nineveh, ending the Neo-Assyrian Empire.

quote.zh-CN: 曾经令近东颤抖的帝国，在尼尼微的灰烬中落幕。
quote.en-US: An empire that terrorized the Near East ended in the ashes of Nineveh.

summary.zh-CN: 佛教创始人乔达摩·悉达多诞生于古印度迦毗罗卫国
summary.en-US: Siddhartha Gautama, founder of Buddhism, was born in Kapilavastu (traditional dating c. 563 BCE).

body.zh-CN: 佛教创始人乔达摩·悉达多诞生于古印度迦毗罗卫国
body.en-US: Buddhist tradition places the birth of Siddhartha Gautama in Kapilavastu. His later awakening and teaching shaped religious and philosophical life across South and East Asia.

quote.zh-CN: 四圣谛与八正道，从此照亮南亚的精神天空。
quote.en-US: The Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path lit a new spiritual horizon in South Asia.

summary.zh-CN: 儒家学派创始人孔子出生于鲁国陬邑
summary.en-US: Confucius, founder of the Confucian school, was born in Zou, State of Lu.

body.zh-CN: 儒家学派创始人孔子出生于鲁国陬邑
body.en-US: In 551 BCE Confucius was born in Lu. His ethical and political teachings later became a cornerstone of East Asian intellectual traditions.

quote.zh-CN: 仁者爱人——东亚伦理秩序由此奠基。
quote.en-US: To love others through benevolence—East Asian ethics found a lasting anchor.

title.zh-CN: 居鲁士大帝征服巴比伦

summary.zh-CN: 波斯阿契美尼德帝国征服巴比伦，释放被囚犹太人。
summary.en-US: The Achaemenid Persians took Babylon and ended the Neo-Babylonian Empire.

body.zh-CN: 居鲁士大帝于公元前539年攻入巴比伦，建立横跨西亚的波斯帝国，并以相对宽容的民族政策著称。
body.en-US: In 539 BCE Cyrus took Babylon and built a vast Persian Empire noted for relatively tolerant rule over subject peoples.

quote.zh-CN: 波斯帝国第一次把西亚、埃及与安纳托利亚联为一体。
quote.en-US: Persia first united Mesopotamia, Egypt, and Anatolia under one empire.

summary.zh-CN: 罗马推翻王政，建立共和国体制
summary.en-US: Rome expelled its kings and established republican institutions around 509 BCE.

body.zh-CN: 罗马推翻王政，建立共和国体制
body.en-US: Roman tradition dates the end of monarchy to 509 BCE, when consuls and the Senate became central. Republican institutions later framed Roman expansion across the Mediterranean.

quote.zh-CN: 罗马共和国取代王政，公民政治实验由此展开。
quote.en-US: The Republic replaced kingship—Rome’s experiment in civic politics began.

summary.zh-CN: 雅典在马拉松战役中击败波斯大军
summary.en-US: Athens defeated a Persian force at Marathon in 490 BCE.

body.zh-CN: 雅典在马拉松战役中击败波斯大军
body.en-US: The Athenian victory at Marathon checked the first major Persian invasion of mainland Greece and became a founding memory of classical Greek identity.

quote.zh-CN: 马拉松的尘土里，雅典公民制赢得了喘息之机。
quote.en-US: In the dust of Marathon, Athenian democracy won a breath of survival.

title.en-US: End of the Spring and Autumn Period

summary.zh-CN: 《春秋》记事止于鲁哀公十六年（前481年）。战国时代起始年代学界有前481、前475、前403等说。
summary.en-US: The Spring and Autumn Annals end in 481 BCE; scholars propose various dates for the start of the Warring States era.

body.zh-CN: 《春秋》记事止于鲁哀公十六年（前481年）。战国时代起始年代学界有前481、前475、前403等说。
body.en-US: Confucian editing of Lu's chronicle stops at 481 BCE, marking a conventional end to the Spring and Autumn era. Historians variously date the Warring States period from 481, 475, or 403 BCE.

alt.zh-CN: 文庙（春秋战国文化背景）
alt.en-US: Confucius temple (Spring and Autumn era context)

quote.zh-CN: 《春秋》绝笔，礼崩乐坏——一个旧时代在史书中悄然落幕。
quote.en-US: The Spring and Autumn Annals ended—ritual order frayed and an old era closed in text.

summary.zh-CN: 希腊哲学家苏格拉底被雅典法庭判处饮鸩而亡
summary.en-US: Socrates was condemned by an Athenian court and died by hemlock in 399 BCE.

body.zh-CN: 希腊哲学家苏格拉底被雅典法庭判处饮鸩而亡
body.en-US: Tried for impiety and corrupting the youth, Socrates accepted the death sentence. Plato's dialogues made the event a landmark in Western philosophy.

alt.en-US: The Death of Socrates by Jacques-Louis David

image.credit: Wikimedia Commons / Metropolitan Museum of Art

quote.zh-CN: 未经省察的人生不值得过。
quote.en-US: The unexamined life is not worth living.

summary.zh-CN: 商鞅在秦国推行变法，为秦统一六国奠定基础
summary.en-US: Shang Yang launched Legalist reforms in Qin that strengthened the state for later conquest.

body.zh-CN: 商鞅在秦国推行变法，为秦统一六国奠定基础
body.en-US: From 356 BCE Shang Yang reorganized Qin law, agriculture, and military service. The reforms are often credited with enabling Qin's eventual unification.

alt.zh-CN: 秦法变革时代相关画像

quote.zh-CN: 废井田、奖军功——商鞅以严刑重法重塑秦国筋骨。
quote.en-US: Abolish well-fields, reward military merit—Shang Yang remade Qin with harsh law.

summary.zh-CN: 腓力二世遇刺，亚历山大继位，随后发动东征。
summary.en-US: After Philip II's assassination, Alexander became king and launched his eastern campaigns.

body.zh-CN: 腓力二世遇刺，亚历山大继位，随后发动东征。
body.en-US: After Philip II's assassination, Alexander became king and launched his eastern campaigns.

quote.zh-CN: 一位年轻国王登基，即将把希腊世界推向亚洲腹地。
quote.en-US: A young king would push the Greek world deep into Asia.

summary.zh-CN: 亚历山大率军东征波斯帝国，开启希腊化时代
summary.en-US: Alexander invaded the Persian Empire in 334 BCE, opening the Hellenistic age.

body.zh-CN: 亚历山大率军东征波斯帝国，开启希腊化时代
body.en-US: Crossing into Asia, Alexander defeated Persian forces and carried Macedonian power deep into West Asia and Egypt, spreading Greek cultural forms across the conquered lands.

sources: 阿里安《亚历山大远征记》

quote.zh-CN: 亚历山大东征，把希腊文化播撒从埃及一直延伸到中亚。
quote.en-US: Alexander's march scattered Greek culture from Egypt deep into Central Asia.

summary.zh-CN: 高加米拉战役，亚历山大击败波斯帝国大流士三世
summary.en-US: Alexander the Great defeated Darius III at Gaugamela, opening the Hellenistic age.

body.zh-CN: 高加米拉战役，亚历山大击败波斯帝国大流士三世
body.en-US: In 331 BCE at Gaugamela, Alexander of Macedon defeated the Achaemenid army of Darius III. The victory paved the way for Greek cultural influence across West Asia and Egypt.

sources: 阿里安《亚历山大远征记》

alt.zh-CN: 伊苏斯战役马赛克中的亚历山大
alt.en-US: Alexander in the Battle of Issus mosaic

image.credit: Wikimedia Commons / Naples National Archaeological Museum

quote.zh-CN: 高加米拉之后，波斯帝国的大门向希腊世界敞开。
quote.en-US: After Gaugamela, the gates of the Persian Empire opened to the Greek world.

text.zh-CN: 我们追击波斯国王，直到他再次逃离战场——东方似乎已在脚下。
text.en-US: We pursued the Persian king until he fled the field again—the East seemed to lie at our feet.

text.zh-CN: 高加米拉附近的村庄里，波斯贵族的妻女在战败后被迫随军东行。
text.en-US: In villages near Gaugamela, Persian noblewomen were marched east with the army after defeat.

label.zh-CN: 希腊文化东传，为地中海世界多元融合铺路
label.en-US: Greek culture spread eastward, preparing the Hellenistic Mediterranean

summary.zh-CN: 旃陀罗笈多推翻难陀王朝，建立孔雀王朝
summary.en-US: Chandragupta Maurya overthrew the Nanda dynasty and founded the Maurya Empire.

body.zh-CN: 旃陀罗笈多推翻难陀王朝，建立孔雀王朝
body.en-US: Around 321 BCE, Chandragupta Maurya established a large Indian empire centered on Magadha. Under later rulers such as Ashoka, Mauryan power and Buddhist patronage reached continental scale.

alt.zh-CN: 桑奇大塔（孔雀王朝佛教艺术）

quote.zh-CN: 孔雀王朝统一印度大部，阿育王曾以佛法治国。
quote.en-US: The Maurya Empire unified much of India—Ashoka once ruled through Buddhist ethics.

summary.zh-CN: 罗马与迦太基争夺西西里，开启三次布匿战争
summary.en-US: Rome and Carthage opened a struggle for Sicily that launched three Punic Wars.

body.zh-CN: 罗马与迦太基争夺西西里，开启三次布匿战争
body.en-US: In 264 BCE conflict over Sicily sparked the First Punic War. The long contest forced Rome to build a navy and began its rise as a Mediterranean great power.

quote.zh-CN: 第一次布匿战争，罗马与迦太基争夺地中海霸权。
quote.en-US: The First Punic War—Rome and Carthage fought for the Mediterranean.

alt.zh-CN: 布匿战争时期罗马战船马赛克

summary.zh-CN: 秦王嬴政灭六国，建立中国历史上第一个中央集权制王朝
summary.en-US: Ying Zheng conquered the six states and founded China's first centralized imperial dynasty.

body.zh-CN: 秦王嬴政灭六国，建立中国历史上第一个中央集权制王朝
body.en-US: In 221 BCE, King Ying Zheng completed the conquest of rival states and proclaimed himself First Emperor of Qin. He unified script, currency, and weights and measures, reshaping Chinese political institutions for centuries.

alt.en-US: Portrait of Qin Shi Huang (19th-century illustration)

quote.zh-CN: 书同文、车同轨——一个帝国试图把天下铸成一体。
quote.en-US: One script, one track—an empire tried to cast all under heaven into a single mold.

text.zh-CN: 咸阳宫中的群臣俯伏在地，六国旧日的旗帜被一一撤下——天下从此只有一个皇帝。
text.en-US: In the palace at Xianyang, courtiers prostrated themselves as the banners of the six former states were taken down—there would be only one emperor under Heaven.

text.zh-CN: 关东来的役夫正在修筑驰道，驿卒抱着统一后的尺度和衡器向各郡进发。
text.en-US: Laborers from the east worked on imperial highways; couriers carried standardized weights and measures to every commandery.

label.zh-CN: 春秋战国数百年争霸，为统一奠定制度与军事基础
label.en-US: Centuries of Warring States conflict laid military and institutional foundations for unification

label.zh-CN: 秦制成为后世王朝的治理模板，汉承秦制
label.en-US: Qin institutions became a template later dynasties adapted—Han inherited Qin structures

summary.zh-CN: 秦始皇命史禄开凿灵渠，连接长江与珠江水系
summary.en-US: Qin engineers linked the Yangtze and Pearl river systems via the Lingqu Canal.

body.zh-CN: 秦始皇命史禄开凿灵渠，连接长江与珠江水系
body.en-US: Around 214 BCE, Shi Lu directed excavation of the Lingqu. The canal supported southern logistics and remains one of China's earliest major hydraulic works.

quote.zh-CN: 灵渠贯通湘漓，秦帝国工程连接长江与珠江。
quote.en-US: The Lingqu Canal linked the Xiang and Li—Qin engineering joined two river systems.

summary.zh-CN: 刘邦率先攻入咸阳，秦朝灭亡，汉朝奠基
summary.en-US: Liu Bang was first to enter Xianyang; the Qin dynasty fell and Han foundations were laid.

body.zh-CN: 刘邦率先攻入咸阳，秦朝灭亡，汉朝奠基
body.en-US: After Qin collapse, Liu Bang occupied the Qin capital Xianyang and accepted the surrender of Ziying. Though he later withdrew under agreement with Xiang Yu, the moment marked Qin's end and Liu's rise toward empire.

alt.zh-CN: 汉长安城未央宫前殿遗址
alt.en-US: Front hall site of Weiyang Palace, Han Chang'an

quote.zh-CN: 先入咸阳者王——刘邦在秦都废墟上接过历史递来的玉玺。
quote.en-US: He who enters Xianyang first shall rule—Liu Bang took the seal amid Qin's ruins.

summary.zh-CN: 刘邦在垓下击败项羽，西汉正式建立
summary.en-US: Liu Bang defeated Xiang Yu at Gaixia, paving the way for the Western Han dynasty.

body.zh-CN: 刘邦在垓下击败项羽，西汉正式建立
body.en-US: At Gaixia, Han forces encircled Xiang Yu's army. His defeat and death ended the Chu-Han contention and allowed Liu Bang to proclaim the Han dynasty in 202 BCE.

quote.zh-CN: 垓下四面楚歌，项羽乌江自刎，楚汉之争尘埃落定。
quote.en-US: Chu songs surrounded Gaixia—Xiang Yu fell at the Wu River; the Chu–Han struggle ended.

summary.zh-CN: 刘邦称帝，建立西汉，定都长安
summary.en-US: Liu Bang became emperor and founded the Western Han with its capital at Chang'an.

body.zh-CN: 刘邦称帝，建立西汉，定都长安
body.en-US: After defeating Xiang Yu, Liu Bang proclaimed the Han dynasty in 202 BCE. Han institutions and cultural patterns became a long-lived reference for later Chinese empires.

alt.zh-CN: 汉长安城未央宫遗址（西汉都城）
alt.en-US: Weiyang Palace site, capital of Western Han Chang'an

quote.zh-CN: 汉高祖定都长安，汉族与汉文化之名由此流传。
quote.en-US: Gaozu made Chang'an capital—the name Han would echo through history.

summary.zh-CN: 第三次布匿战争结束，罗马彻底摧毁迦太基城。
summary.en-US: Rome destroyed Carthage, ending the Third Punic War.

body.zh-CN: 第三次布匿战争结束，罗马彻底摧毁迦太基城。
body.en-US: Rome destroyed Carthage, ending the Third Punic War.

quote.zh-CN: 迦太基必须毁灭——地中海从此成为罗马的内湖。
quote.en-US: Carthage must be destroyed—the Mediterranean became Rome's lake.

summary.zh-CN: 凯撒率军渡过卢比孔河，罗马内战爆发，共和国命运已定。
summary.en-US: Caesar crossed the Rubicon, triggering civil war and the Republic's fate.

body.zh-CN: 凯撒率军渡过卢比孔河，罗马内战爆发，共和国命运已定。
body.en-US: Caesar crossed the Rubicon, triggering civil war and the Republic's fate.

quote.zh-CN: 骰子已经掷出——共和国的最后一页即将翻过。
quote.en-US: The die is cast—the Republic's last page was turning.

summary.zh-CN: 元老院议员在庞培剧场刺杀凯撒，罗马共和国政治危机加剧。
summary.en-US: Senators assassinated Caesar in the Theatre of Pompey, deepening Rome's crisis.

body.zh-CN: 元老院议员在庞培剧场刺杀凯撒，罗马共和国政治危机加剧。
body.en-US: Senators assassinated Caesar in the Theatre of Pompey, deepening Rome's crisis.

quote.zh-CN: 你也一样，布鲁utus？——共和与独裁的冲突以血收束。
quote.en-US: Et tu, Brute?—Republic and dictatorship ended in blood.

title.zh-CN: 奥古斯都建立罗马帝国

summary.zh-CN: 屋大维获封'奥古斯都'，罗马共和国终结，帝国开启
summary.en-US: Octavian received the title Augustus, marking the transition from Republic to Empire.

body.zh-CN: 屋大维获封'奥古斯都'，罗马共和国终结，帝国开启
body.en-US: In 27 BCE, the Roman Senate granted Octavian the honorific Augustus. He retained republican forms while consolidating imperial power, inaugurating the Principate and the Pax Romana.

sources: 苏埃托尼乌斯《罗马十二帝王传》

alt.zh-CN: 奥古斯都雕像（普里马波尔塔）

quote.zh-CN: 共和国的外衣仍在，帝国的权柄已归屋大维。
quote.en-US: The Republic's mask remained; imperial power now rested with Octavian.

text.zh-CN: 我接受「奥古斯都」之名，以恢复共和国为名，实则重建秩序。
text.en-US: I accept the name Augustus—in the name of restoring the Republic, I rebuild order.

text.zh-CN: 罗马广场上的公民仍参加选举，但已习惯仰望广场另一端新建的奥古斯都雕像。
text.en-US: Citizens still voted in the Forum, but already looked toward the new statue of Augustus at its edge.

label.zh-CN: 帝国体制延续四百年，终在395年分裂为东西两部分
label.en-US: The imperial system endured four centuries until the split of 395

summary.zh-CN: 现行公历纪年以耶稣诞生为起点。耶稣实际生年无确证，不宜视为精确历史日期。
summary.en-US: The Gregorian calendar epoch is anchored to the birth of Jesus; his actual birth year is not securely known.

body.zh-CN: 现行公历纪年以耶稣诞生为起点。耶稣实际生年无确证，不宜视为精确历史日期。
body.en-US: Dionysius Exiguus later fixed year 1 CE as the Nativity epoch for Christian chronology. Modern scholarship generally places Jesus' birth several years earlier, so the date is conventional rather than precise.

events.review_note: 坐标改为伯利恒一带示意，非事件精确发生地

quote.zh-CN: 公元纪年从此成为丈量人类历史的共同尺度。
quote.en-US: The Common Era became a shared ruler for measuring human history.

summary.zh-CN: 刘秀称帝，建立东汉，定都洛阳
summary.en-US: Liu Xiu restored Han rule as Emperor Guangwu, with the capital at Luoyang.

body.zh-CN: 刘秀称帝，建立东汉，定都洛阳
body.en-US: In 25 CE Liu Xiu proclaimed the Eastern Han after the collapse of Wang Mang's Xin. The dynasty recentered imperial authority and Confucian administration for another two centuries.

quote.zh-CN: 光武帝刘秀称帝，汉朝国祚在洛阳延续。
quote.en-US: Emperor Guangwu proclaimed the Han restored—its mandate continued in Luoyang.

title.en-US: Ban Chao's Mission to the Western Regions

summary.zh-CN: 班超奉命出使西域，恢复汉朝对西域的控制
summary.en-US: Ban Chao restored Han influence across the Tarim Basin oasis states.

body.zh-CN: 班超奉命出使西域，恢复汉朝对西域的控制
body.en-US: From 73 CE Ban Chao operated as envoy and commander in the Western Regions. His career secured routes later remembered as part of the Silk Road network.

quote.zh-CN: 班超投笔从戎，再通西域，丝绸之路在东汉重光。
quote.en-US: Ban Chao turned from brush to sword—reopening the Western Regions and the Silk Road.

summary.zh-CN: 蔡伦向汉和帝献上改进后的造纸工艺
summary.en-US: Cai Lun presented improved papermaking techniques to the Han court in 105 CE.

body.zh-CN: 蔡伦向汉和帝献上改进后的造纸工艺
body.en-US: Whether Cai Lun invented paper or refined earlier craft, his report marks a milestone in writing technology that later transformed administration and learning across Eurasia.

quote.zh-CN: 一纸蔡侯纸，让文明有了更轻便的载体。
quote.en-US: With Cai Lun's paper, civilization gained a lighter vessel for memory.

title.en-US: Fall of Eastern Han · Three Kingdoms Begin

summary.zh-CN: 汉献帝退位，曹魏代汉，三国鼎立局面开启
summary.en-US: Emperor Xian abdicated; Cao Wei replaced Han and the Three Kingdoms era opened.

body.zh-CN: 汉献帝退位，曹魏代汉，三国鼎立局面开启
body.en-US: In 220 CE Cao Pi forced Emperor Xian's abdication and founded Wei. Rival regimes in Shu and Wu completed a tripartite division that later became famous in Chinese historical romance.

alt.en-US: Statue of Guan Yu (Three Kingdoms icon)

quote.zh-CN: 汉献帝禅让，三国鼎立的棋局正式开局。
quote.en-US: The emperor abdicated—the Three Kingdoms game officially began.

summary.zh-CN: 司马炎篡魏，建立西晋，三国时代终结
summary.en-US: Sima Yan usurped Wei and founded the Western Jin, ending the Three Kingdoms.

body.zh-CN: 司马炎篡魏，建立西晋，三国时代终结
body.en-US: In 265 CE Sima Yan established the Jin dynasty. Brief reunification followed the conquest of Wu, before later crises again fragmented northern China.

quote.zh-CN: 司马炎代魏建晋，三国归于一统。
quote.en-US: Sima Yan founded Jin—the Three Kingdoms returned to one realm.

summary.zh-CN: 君士坦丁大帝颁布米兰敕令，承认基督教合法
summary.en-US: Constantine and Licinius granted legal toleration to Christianity in 313 CE.

body.zh-CN: 君士坦丁大帝颁布米兰敕令，承认基督教合法
body.en-US: The Edict of Milan ended official persecution of Christians in the Roman Empire and opened the path for Christianity's public institutional rise.

quote.zh-CN: 米兰敕令之后，信仰从地下走向公开。
quote.en-US: After the Edict of Milan, faith stepped from hiding into the open.

summary.zh-CN: 狄奥多西一世逝世后，罗马分裂为东西两部分
summary.en-US: After Theodosius I died in 395, the empire permanently split into eastern and western halves.

body.zh-CN: 狄奥多西一世逝世后，罗马分裂为东西两部分
body.en-US: Theodosius I's death in 395 left Arcadius in the East and Honorius in the West. The administrative split hardened into separate political trajectories for Byzantium and the Western Empire.

alt.zh-CN: 罗马帝国分裂时代相关雕像

quote.zh-CN: 狄奥多西之后，罗马永久分裂为东西两半。
quote.en-US: After Theodosius, Rome split permanently into East and West.

summary.zh-CN: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘统一黄河流域北方，南北政权对峙局面加剧。南朝政权仍存。
summary.en-US: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei unified the Yellow River basin, intensifying north–south rivalry.

body.zh-CN: 北魏太武帝拓跋焘统一黄河流域北方，南北政权对峙局面加剧。南朝政权仍存。
body.en-US: By 439 CE the Northern Wei under Tuoba Tao had conquered rival northern regimes. Southern dynasties continued, shaping the long Northern and Southern Dynasties period.

alt.zh-CN: 云冈石窟（北魏佛教艺术）

quote.zh-CN: 北魏统一北方，胡汉融合的政治实验在黄河以北展开。
quote.en-US: Northern Wei unified the north—a experiment in blending steppe and Han rule.

summary.zh-CN: 汪达尔人攻入罗马城，进行大规模掠夺
summary.en-US: Vandal forces entered Rome and carried out extensive looting.

body.zh-CN: 汪达尔人攻入罗马城，进行大规模掠夺
body.en-US: In 455 CE Gaiseric's Vandals occupied Rome for two weeks, stripping temples and palaces of movable wealth. The sack shocked the Mediterranean world and became a symbol of Western imperial decline.

quote.zh-CN: 汪达尔洗劫罗马，帝国荣耀在蛮族马蹄下再次蒙尘。
quote.en-US: Vandals sacked Rome—imperial glory was trampled again by barbarian hooves.

title.en-US: Fall of the Western Roman Empire

summary.zh-CN: 蛮族将领奥多亚塞废黜末代皇帝，西罗马帝国终结
summary.en-US: Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus, conventionally ending Western Roman rule.

body.zh-CN: 蛮族将领奥多亚塞废黜末代皇帝，西罗马帝国终结
body.en-US: In 476 CE, the Germanic commander Odoacer deposed the last Western Roman emperor, Romulus Augustulus. Historians often treat this year as a symbolic end of the Western Empire, though transformation had been underway for decades.

sources: 爱德华·吉本《罗马帝国衰亡史》
Gibbon, The History of the Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire

alt.zh-CN: 蛮族冲击罗马相关历史画
alt.en-US: Historical painting related to the sack of Rome

quote.zh-CN: 西罗马的最后一页翻过，中世纪欧洲正在酝酿。
quote.en-US: The last page of the Western Empire turned; medieval Europe was stirring.

text.zh-CN: 拉文纳的宫廷里，最后一位皇帝交出了冠冕——西罗马的名字从此成为过去。
text.en-US: In Ravenna's court the last emperor surrendered his diadem—the name of the Western Empire became past tense.

text.zh-CN: 意大利乡村的农民仍向本地领主交租，不知皇帝的名号已经更换。
text.en-US: Peasants in the Italian countryside still paid rent to local lords, unaware the imperial title had changed hands.

label.zh-CN: 帝国分裂后西线防务与财政长期恶化
label.en-US: After the imperial split, the West suffered chronic military and fiscal strain

label.zh-CN: 地中海旧秩序松动，新帝国与宗教秩序在欧亚非同时生长
label.en-US: The old Mediterranean order loosened as new empires and faiths rose across Eurasia

summary.zh-CN: 查士丁尼成为东罗马帝国皇帝，开启复兴时代
summary.en-US: Justinian became emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire and launched a program of reconquest and law reform.

body.zh-CN: 查士丁尼成为东罗马帝国皇帝，开启复兴时代
body.en-US: In 527 CE Justinian I ascended the Byzantine throne. His reign produced the Corpus Juris Civilis and ambitious campaigns to reclaim former western territories.

image.credit: Wikimedia Commons / Basilica of San Vitale

quote.zh-CN: 查士丁尼即位，东罗马试图在旧帝国废墟上重建法律与荣光。
quote.en-US: Justinian took the throne—Byzantium sought to rebuild law and glory from ruins.

summary.zh-CN: 东罗马帝国颁布《民法大全》，罗马法集大成之作
summary.en-US: The Corpus Juris Civilis systematized Roman law under Justinian I.

body.zh-CN: 东罗马帝国颁布《民法大全》，罗马法集大成之作
body.en-US: Beginning in 529 CE, Justinian's jurists compiled and revised Roman legal texts. The corpus later shaped medieval and modern civil-law traditions.

quote.zh-CN: 查士丁尼法典颁行，罗马法精神影响后世千年。
quote.en-US: The Justinian Code—Roman law would shape civilization for millennia.

summary.zh-CN: 突厥与波斯联军击败嚈哒，突厥势力称霸中亚草原。
summary.en-US: Türk and Sasanian forces crushed the Hephthalites, extending Türk power across Central Asia.

body.zh-CN: 突厥与波斯联军击败嚈哒，突厥势力称霸中亚草原。
body.en-US: Around 554 CE the First Türk Khaganate allied with Persia against the Hephthalites. Victory reshaped steppe politics and opened corridors later tied to Silk Road exchange.

events.review_note: 文明归属由 middle_east 改为 central_asia

quote.zh-CN: 嚈哒灭亡，突厥崛起——中亚草原的权力棋盘再次洗牌。
quote.en-US: The Hephthalites fell and the Turks rose—the Central Asian steppe was reshuffled again.

title.en-US: Sui Conquers Chen and Reunifies China

summary.zh-CN: 隋文帝杨坚攻灭南陈，结束南北朝分裂局面
summary.en-US: Emperor Wen of Sui destroyed Chen, ending centuries of north–south division.

body.zh-CN: 隋文帝杨坚攻灭南陈，结束南北朝分裂局面
body.en-US: In 589 CE Sui armies conquered Jiankang and ended the Chen dynasty. Political reunification prepared the institutional ground for the following Tang flourishing.

quote.zh-CN: 隋文帝一统南北，分裂三百年的中国重归一家。
quote.en-US: Emperor Wen reunified north and south—China became one again after three centuries of division.

summary.zh-CN: 日本圣德太子推行《十七条宪法》等改革。603年为传统纪年，摄政年代学界有不同说法。
summary.en-US: Prince Shōtoku promoted reforms including the Seventeen-Article Constitution; 603 CE is traditional dating with scholarly debate.

body.zh-CN: 日本圣德太子推行《十七条宪法》等改革。603年为传统纪年，摄政年代学界有不同说法。
body.en-US: Court tradition credits Shōtoku with Buddhist patronage, bureaucratic reform, and the Seventeen-Article Constitution. The exact chronology of his regency is debated, but he remains a central figure in early Japanese state formation.

quote.zh-CN: 十七条宪法，圣德太子以律令制度为日本国家奠基。
quote.en-US: Seventeen-Article Constitution—Prince Shōtoku laid Japan's ritsuryō foundations.

summary.zh-CN: 穆罕默德在麦加开始传播伊斯兰教
summary.en-US: Muhammad began proclaiming Islam in Mecca around 610 CE.

body.zh-CN: 穆罕默德在麦加开始传播伊斯兰教
body.en-US: Traditional accounts date the first revelations and early preaching to about 610. The new religious community later reshaped Arabia and much of Afro-Eurasia.

quote.zh-CN: 麦加的一语，将改变从阿拉伯半岛到世界的格局。
quote.en-US: A word in Mecca would reshape the world from Arabia outward.

summary.zh-CN: 李渊称帝，建立唐朝，开启中国古代最繁盛的朝代之一
summary.en-US: Li Yuan proclaimed the Tang dynasty, beginning one of China's most celebrated eras.

body.zh-CN: 李渊称帝，建立唐朝，开启中国古代最繁盛的朝代之一
body.en-US: In 618 CE, Li Yuan (Emperor Gaozu) founded the Tang dynasty with Chang'an as capital. The dynasty later became a cosmopolitan high point of medieval East Asian culture, trade, and governance.

alt.en-US: Portrait of Emperor Taizong of Tang

quote.zh-CN: 长安的钟声响起，盛唐的序幕就此拉开。
quote.en-US: The bells of Chang'an rang— the Tang golden age began.

text.zh-CN: 太极宫的钟磬齐鸣，旧隋的龙旗被换下——长安将再度成为帝国的中心。
text.en-US: Bells and chimes rang in the Taiji Palace as Sui banners came down—Chang'an would again be the heart of empire.

text.zh-CN: 长安西市，胡商正陈列波斯地毯与西域香料，孩童第一次听见「大唐」的名号。
text.en-US: In Chang'an's western market, Sogdian merchants laid out Persian carpets and spices; children heard the name 'Great Tang' for the first time.

label.zh-CN: 隋统南北后迅速崩解，群雄逐鹿关中
label.en-US: After Sui reunification and collapse, warlords fought for the Guanzhong heartland

label.zh-CN: 国力强盛，才有玄奘西行的底气与归来后的译经盛世
label.en-US: Tang power enabled Xuanzang's journey and the translation boom that followed

summary.zh-CN: 穆罕默德从麦加迁徙至麦地那，伊斯兰历纪元开始
summary.en-US: Muhammad and his followers migrated from Mecca to Medina, marking year one of the Islamic calendar.

body.zh-CN: 穆罕默德从麦加迁徙至麦地那，伊斯兰历纪元开始
body.en-US: In 622 CE, Muhammad emigrated from Mecca to Yathrib (later Medina). The Hijra became the epoch of the Islamic lunar calendar and a formative moment for the early Muslim community.

quote.zh-CN: 从麦加到麦地那，迁徙定义了新的纪年。
quote.en-US: From Mecca to Medina—a migration that defined a new calendar.

text.zh-CN: 你们当为麦地那人而战——真主已为你们预备了迁徙与胜利的道路。
text.en-US: Fight for the people of Medina—God has prepared for you a path of migration and victory.

text.zh-CN: 麦地那的辅士打开家门，接纳从麦加逃来的穆斯林，社区以信仰重新缔约。
text.en-US: The Ansar of Medina opened their homes to Muslims fleeing Mecca; the community remade itself by covenant.

label.zh-CN: 伊斯兰世界扩张，与唐朝在西域迟早相遇
label.en-US: Islamic expansion would eventually meet Tang power in Central Asia

summary.zh-CN: 玄奘法师自长安出发西行求法，后抵达天竺。出发年份修正为629年。
summary.en-US: The Tang monk Xuanzang set out for India to seek Buddhist scriptures.

body.zh-CN: 玄奘法师自长安出发西行求法，后抵达天竺。出发年份修正为629年。
body.en-US: In 629 CE, Xuanzang left Chang'an for India. After years of travel and study, he returned with Buddhist texts that deeply influenced East Asian Buddhism and later inspired Journey to the West.

sources: Great Tang Records on the Western Regions
events.review_note: 年份由627修正为629；坐标为长安

quote.zh-CN: 一僧西行，为东亚文明带回整片天竺的典籍与记忆。
quote.en-US: One monk westward—bringing India’s texts and memory back to East Asia.

text.zh-CN: 若不西求佛法，则东土何由得正典？
text.en-US: If I do not seek the Dharma in the West, how shall the Eastern lands obtain the true canon?

source.en-US: Preface to Great Tang Records on the Western Regions

text.zh-CN: 玉门关外的商旅目送一位僧人背影远去，驼铃在戈壁的风里渐渐听不清。
text.en-US: Merchants at Yumen Pass watched a monk's figure fade; camel bells vanished in the desert wind.

label.zh-CN: 盛唐国力强盛、长安开放，才有西行求法的条件
label.en-US: A strong, cosmopolitan Tang Chang'an made the westward pilgrimage possible

label.zh-CN: 佛教东传与西域交通，最终在怛罗斯与伊斯兰世界碰撞
label.en-US: Buddhist transmission and Central Asian routes later collided with Islam at Talas

summary.zh-CN: 日本孝德天皇推行大化改新，全面学习唐制
summary.en-US: Emperor Kotoku launched the Taika Reform, adopting Tang-style institutions in Japan.

body.zh-CN: 日本孝德天皇推行大化改新，全面学习唐制
body.en-US: In 645 CE court reformers sought to centralize power along Chinese models. The Taika era marks a decisive turn toward ritsuryo state-building in Japan.

quote.zh-CN: 大化改新，日本全面学习唐制，走向律令国家。
quote.en-US: The Taika Reform—Japan adopted Tang institutions toward a ritsuryō state.

summary.zh-CN: 阿拉伯帝国征服萨珊波斯，伊斯兰教在波斯传播
summary.en-US: Arab armies conquered the Sasanian Empire and Islam spread across Persia.

body.zh-CN: 阿拉伯帝国征服萨珊波斯，伊斯兰教在波斯传播
body.en-US: By 651 CE Arab-Muslim forces had ended Sasanian rule. Persian elites gradually converted and helped shape Islamic civilization, blending Arabic administration with Persian literary and administrative traditions.

sources: al-Tabari, History of the Prophets and Kings

quote.zh-CN: 萨珊波斯陨落，伊斯兰信仰在伊朗高原扎根。
quote.en-US: Sasanian Persia fell—Islam took root on the Iranian plateau.

summary.zh-CN: 新罗最终统一朝鲜半岛大部，形成统一的新罗王朝。668年灭高句丽，676年击败百济残余势力后完成统一。
summary.en-US: Silla completed the unification of most of the peninsula after defeating rival kingdoms.

body.zh-CN: 新罗最终统一朝鲜半岛大部，形成统一的新罗王朝。668年灭高句丽，676年击败百济残余势力后完成统一。
body.en-US: After destroying Goguryeo in 668 and clearing Baekje remnants by 676, Silla consolidated a unified kingdom. The settlement reshaped East Asian geopolitics beside Tang China.

events.review_note: 统一完成年份由668修正为676

quote.zh-CN: 新罗统一半岛，朝鲜民族国家的雏形确立。
quote.en-US: Silla unified the peninsula—the Korean state took shape.

summary.zh-CN: 阿拉伯军队渡过直布罗陀海峡，征服伊比利亚半岛
summary.en-US: Berber and Arab armies crossed the Strait of Gibraltar and conquered much of the Iberian Peninsula.

body.zh-CN: 阿拉伯军队渡过直布罗陀海峡，征服伊比利亚半岛
body.en-US: In 711 CE Tariq ibn Ziyad's forces defeated the Visigothic kingdom. Muslim rule in al-Andalus introduced new agriculture, urban culture, and learning that reshaped medieval Spain.

sources: Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Conquest of Egypt and Maghrib

alt.zh-CN: 格拉纳达阿尔罕布拉宫

quote.zh-CN: 塔里克渡海，伊斯兰世界与基督教欧洲在伊比利亚短兵相接。
quote.en-US: Tariq crossed the strait—Islam and Christian Europe clashed in Iberia.

summary.zh-CN: 铁锤查理在普瓦提埃击败穆斯林军队，阻止伊斯兰教西进
summary.en-US: Charles Martel defeated a Muslim army at Poitiers, halting further expansion into Francia.

body.zh-CN: 铁锤查理在普瓦提埃击败穆斯林军队，阻止伊斯兰教西进
body.en-US: In 732 CE Frankish forces under Charles Martel repulsed Umayyad raiders near Poitiers. Medieval writers saw the battle as a turning point that checked Muslim advance into Western Europe.

quote.zh-CN: 普瓦提埃之战，铁锤查理阻挡了穆斯林军队北上。
quote.en-US: At Tours, Charles Martel halted the Muslim advance into northern Europe.

summary.zh-CN: 唐朝与阿拉伯帝国在中亚怛罗斯交战，造纸术由此西传
summary.en-US: Tang and Abbasid forces clashed at Talas in 751; papermaking knowledge later spread westward.

body.zh-CN: 唐朝与阿拉伯帝国在中亚怛罗斯交战，造纸术由此西传
body.en-US: The Battle of Talas checked Tang expansion in Central Asia. Captured craftsmen are often linked in later sources to the westward transmission of papermaking.

quote.zh-CN: 怛罗斯之败，造纸术却沿着丝路西传。
quote.en-US: Defeat at Talas—yet papermaking traveled west along the Silk Road.

alt.zh-CN: 唐代士兵图（怛罗斯时代背景）

summary.zh-CN: 教皇利奥三世为查理曼加冕为'罗马人的皇帝'
summary.en-US: Pope Leo III crowned Charlemagne 'Emperor of the Romans' in Rome on Christmas Day 800.

body.zh-CN: 教皇利奥三世为查理曼加冕为'罗马人的皇帝'
body.en-US: The 800 coronation linked Frankish power with Roman imperial symbolism. It became a founding moment for later Western ideas of empire and Christian kingship.

quote.zh-CN: 圣诞日的加冕，查理曼试图复兴罗马的荣光。
quote.en-US: Crowned on Christmas Day, Charlemagne sought to revive Rome’s glory.

summary.zh-CN: 阇耶跋摩二世在柬埔寨建立吴哥王朝，高棉帝国时代开始。
summary.en-US: Jayavarman II founded the Khmer Empire in Cambodia.

body.zh-CN: 阇耶跋摩二世在柬埔寨建立吴哥王朝，高棉帝国时代开始。
body.en-US: Jayavarman II founded the Khmer Empire in Cambodia.

quote.zh-CN: 东南亚最大帝国在雨林与水利工程中崛起。
quote.en-US: Southeast Asia's greatest empire rose through jungle and hydraulic engineering.

title.zh-CN: 阿拉伯百年翻译运动鼎盛
title.en-US: Peak of the Abbasid Translation Movement

summary.zh-CN: 阿拔斯王朝在巴格达大规模翻译希腊、波斯、印度典籍
summary.en-US: The Abbasid caliphate in Baghdad undertook large-scale translation of Greek, Persian, and Indian works.

body.zh-CN: 阿拔斯王朝在巴格达大规模翻译希腊、波斯、印度典籍
body.en-US: Under caliphs such as al-Ma'mun, scholars at the House of Wisdom rendered scientific and philosophical texts into Arabic. The movement preserved and extended classical knowledge for medieval Islam and later Europe.

alt.zh-CN: 阿拔斯哈里发马蒙（百年翻译运动赞助者）

quote.zh-CN: 百年翻译运动，把希腊、波斯、印度的典籍汇入阿拉伯学术宝库。
quote.en-US: The Translation Movement poured Greek, Persian, and Indian texts into Arabic learning.

summary.zh-CN: 查理曼帝国三分，奠定法兰西、德意志、意大利雏形
summary.en-US: Charlemagne's grandsons partitioned the empire, outlining early France, Germany, and Italy.

body.zh-CN: 查理曼帝国三分，奠定法兰西、德意志、意大利雏形
body.en-US: The 843 Treaty of Verdun divided Carolingian lands among Lothair, Louis the German, and Charles the Bald. The settlement is often treated as a formative step toward later European polities.

quote.zh-CN: 凡尔登条约划出的边界，至今仍在欧洲地图上低语。
quote.en-US: The lines drawn at Verdun still whisper across Europe’s map.

summary.zh-CN: 现存最早有明确刊印纪年的《金刚经》卷发现于敦煌莫高窟。原卷藏于大英图书馆。
summary.en-US: The earliest dated printed Diamond Sutra scroll was produced in 868 and later found at Dunhuang.

body.zh-CN: 现存最早有明确刊印纪年的《金刚经》卷发现于敦煌莫高窟。原卷藏于大英图书馆。
body.en-US: A woodblock-printed Diamond Sutra dated 868 survives from the Dunhuang cache. It is a key landmark in the global history of print.

sources: 大英图书馆藏《金刚经》卷
events.review_note: 坐标修正为敦煌（发现地），非长安

quote.zh-CN: 敦煌金刚经，世界现存最早有纪年的印刷品。
quote.en-US: The Diamond Sutra from Dunhuang—the earliest dated printed book known.

summary.zh-CN: 朱温篡唐，建立后梁，中国进入五代十国分裂时期
summary.en-US: Zhu Wen usurped Tang and founded Later Liang, opening the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms era.

body.zh-CN: 朱温篡唐，建立后梁，中国进入五代十国分裂时期
body.en-US: In 907 Zhu Wen forced the last Tang emperor to abdicate. Political fragmentation followed until the Song gradually reunified much of China.

sources: Old History of the Five Dynasties

quote.zh-CN: 大唐289年的国祚终结，分裂的五代十国时代来临。
quote.en-US: After 289 years the Tang fell— an era of fragmentation began.

title.en-US: Battle of Bạch Đằng · Vietnam Independent

summary.zh-CN: 吴权在白藤江击败南汉，越南脱离中国直接统治，独立政权开端。
summary.en-US: Ngo Quyen defeated the Southern Han at Bach Dang, beginning independent Vietnamese rule.

body.zh-CN: 吴权在白藤江击败南汉，越南脱离中国直接统治，独立政权开端。
body.en-US: Ngo Quyen defeated the Southern Han at Bach Dang, beginning independent Vietnamese rule.

quote.zh-CN: 白藤江的桩阵，把越南从北属时期推向独立国家。
quote.en-US: Stakes on the Bach Dang pushed Vietnam from Chinese rule toward independence.

summary.zh-CN: 赵匡胤陈桥兵变后建立宋朝，结束五代十国分裂。
summary.en-US: Zhao Kuangyin founded the Song, ending the Five Dynasties period.

body.zh-CN: 赵匡胤陈桥兵变后建立宋朝，结束五代十国分裂。
body.en-US: Zhao Kuangyin founded the Song, ending the Five Dynasties period.

quote.zh-CN: 杯酒释兵权之后，文官政治与商业繁荣的宋代中国开启。
quote.en-US: After the cup of wine, Song China opened to civilian rule and commercial prosperity.

summary.zh-CN: 赵匡胤黄袍加身，建立宋朝，五代十国结束
summary.en-US: Zhao Kuangyin seized power and founded the Song dynasty.

body.zh-CN: 赵匡胤黄袍加身，建立宋朝，五代十国结束
body.en-US: In 960 CE, Zhao Kuangyin was acclaimed emperor at Chenqiao and established the Song dynasty. Song China became known for commercial growth, civil examination culture, and technological innovation.

quote.zh-CN: 黄袍加身，陈桥驿的兵变改写了中国近世的政治逻辑。
quote.en-US: The yellow robe at Chen Bridge rewrote the logic of Chinese politics.

text.zh-CN: 陈桥驿的清晨，黄袍加身的喧哗声中，五代十国的乱世终于走向尾声。
text.en-US: At dawn in Chenqiao, amid the clamor of a yellow robe placed on his shoulders, the chaos of Five Dynasties began to end.

text.zh-CN: 开封城里的酒肆伙计听说新朝号「宋」，悄悄把价签上的旧年号撕去。
text.en-US: Tavern workers in Kaifeng heard the new dynasty was called 'Song' and quietly peeled old reign marks off price tags.

label.zh-CN: 宋代商业与科举文化，与同期欧洲封建秩序形成对照
label.en-US: Song commerce and examination culture contrasted with contemporary European feudal order

title.zh-CN: 奥托一世加冕神圣罗马帝国
title.en-US: Otto I Crowned Holy Roman Emperor

summary.zh-CN: 德意志国王奥托一世在罗马加冕，神圣罗马帝国传统由此开端。
summary.en-US: Otto I was crowned in Rome, beginning the Holy Roman Empire tradition.

body.zh-CN: 德意志国王奥托一世在罗马加冕，神圣罗马帝国传统由此开端。
body.en-US: Otto I was crowned in Rome, beginning the Holy Roman Empire tradition.

quote.zh-CN: 中欧政治秩序在罗马加冕与德意志王权之间重新缝合。
quote.en-US: Central Europe's order was stitched between Roman coronation and German kingship.

title.zh-CN: 莱夫·埃里克松抵达美洲

summary.zh-CN: 北欧萨迦记载维京人莱夫·埃里克松抵达北美文兰。证据主要来自文献传说，考古仍在进行。
summary.en-US: Norse sagas credit Leif Erikson with reaching Vinland around 1000 CE.

body.zh-CN: 北欧萨迦记载维京人莱夫·埃里克松抵达北美文兰。证据主要来自文献传说，考古仍在进行。
body.en-US: Icelandic sagas describe Norse voyages to Vinland. Archaeological work at L'Anse aux Meadows supports Norse presence in North America around the turn of the millennium.

quote.zh-CN: 维京传说中西抵文兰，哥伦布之前可能已有跨洋接触。
quote.en-US: Saga tells of Vinland—possible transatlantic contact before Columbus.

title.en-US: Destruction of the Church of the Holy Sepulchre

summary.zh-CN: 法蒂玛王朝哈里发下令拆毁耶路撒冷圣墓教堂，引发基督教世界震动
summary.en-US: A Fatimid caliph ordered the demolition of Jerusalem's Church of the Holy Sepulchre, shocking Christendom.

body.zh-CN: 法蒂玛王朝哈里发下令拆毁耶路撒冷圣墓教堂，引发基督教世界震动
body.en-US: Al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah's destruction of the Holy Sepulchre in 1009 CE outraged Christian Europe and was later cited among motives for crusading. The church was rebuilt after Fatimid policy softened.

sources: Yahya ibn Sa'id of Antioch, Chronicle

quote.zh-CN: 圣墓教堂被毁，十字军东征的导火索之一。
quote.en-US: The Holy Sepulchre destroyed—one spark that led to the Crusades.

summary.zh-CN: 天主教与东正教正式分裂，史称'大分裂'
summary.en-US: Mutual excommunications in 1054 formalized the Catholic–Orthodox schism.

body.zh-CN: 天主教与东正教正式分裂，史称'大分裂'
body.en-US: Long-standing doctrinal and political tensions culminated in 1054. The rupture between Rome and Constantinople shaped Christian institutional geography for centuries.

quote.zh-CN: 1054年的裂帛，基督教世界从此东西分立。
quote.en-US: The schism of 1054 split Christendom into East and West.

alt.zh-CN: 圣索菲亚大教堂（1054大分裂背景）

summary.zh-CN: 威廉在黑斯廷斯战役中获胜，成为英格兰国王
summary.en-US: William of Normandy defeated Harold Godwinson at Hastings and took the English crown.

body.zh-CN: 威廉在黑斯廷斯战役中获胜，成为英格兰国王
body.en-US: In 1066, Duke William of Normandy invaded England and won the Battle of Hastings. The Norman Conquest transformed English language, aristocracy, and institutions.

alt.zh-CN: 贝叶挂毯中的黑斯廷斯战役场景
alt.en-US: Battle of Hastings scene from the Bayeux Tapestry

quote.zh-CN: 黑斯廷斯的一战，诺曼人把欧洲大陆的制度带入英格兰。
quote.en-US: At Hastings, Normans brought continental institutions into England.

text.zh-CN: 威廉国王在此战胜英格兰人——此战之后，英格兰将改换主人。
text.en-US: King William has conquered the English here—after this battle England will have a new lord.

text.zh-CN: 黑斯廷斯附近的农妇在战壕外收拾散落的箭矢，不知道诺曼法语即将进入她的语言。
text.en-US: Near Hastings, a peasant woman gathered stray arrows beyond the ditch, not knowing Norman French would enter her tongue.

label.zh-CN: 欧洲封建秩序固化，与草原帝国即将形成的另一极遥相对峙
label.en-US: European feudal order hardened as a steppe empire formed another pole of power

summary.zh-CN: 塞尔柱突厥击败拜占庭皇帝罗曼四世，拜占庭丧失安纳托利亚大部。
summary.en-US: Seljuk Turks defeated Emperor Romanos IV; Byzantium lost much of Anatolia.

body.zh-CN: 塞尔柱突厥击败拜占庭皇帝罗曼四世，拜占庭丧失安纳托利亚大部。
body.en-US: Seljuk Turks defeated Emperor Romanos IV; Byzantium lost much of Anatolia.

quote.zh-CN: 一场战役改变了安纳托利亚的主人，土耳其历史由此转折。
quote.en-US: One battle changed the master of Anatolia—Turkish history turned here.

summary.zh-CN: 第一次十字军于1096年启程东征，1099年攻占耶路撒冷。此处取东征开始年份。
summary.en-US: The First Crusade set out in 1096 and captured Jerusalem in 1099.

body.zh-CN: 第一次十字军于1096年启程东征，1099年攻占耶路撒冷。此处取东征开始年份。
body.en-US: Responding to papal calls, crusading armies marched east. The campaign established Latin states in the Levant and intensified Christian–Muslim conflict.

alt.zh-CN: 第一次十字军东征·耶路撒冷围城

quote.zh-CN: 十字军东征启程，宗教与利益交织的远征改变地中海世界。
quote.en-US: The Crusades set out—faith and profit reshaped the Mediterranean world.

summary.zh-CN: 高棉帝国开始建造吴哥窟，东南亚最宏伟的宗教建筑群
summary.en-US: The Khmer Empire began building Angkor Wat, Southeast Asia's most monumental temple complex.

body.zh-CN: 高棉帝国开始建造吴哥窟，东南亚最宏伟的宗教建筑群
body.en-US: Around the early 12th century under Suryavarman II, Angkor Wat rose as a vast Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu. It later became a Buddhist site and a lasting symbol of Khmer civilization.

quote.zh-CN: 吴哥窟动工，高棉帝国以石庙书写东南亚的辉煌。
quote.en-US: Angkor Wat began— the Khmer Empire carved glory in stone.

summary.zh-CN: 金军攻破开封，徽钦二帝被俘，北宋灭亡，宋室南渡。
summary.en-US: Jurchen forces captured Kaifeng and emperors; the Northern Song fell and the court fled south.

body.zh-CN: 金军攻破开封，徽钦二帝被俘，北宋灭亡，宋室南渡。
body.en-US: Jurchen forces captured Kaifeng and emperors; the Northern Song fell and the court fled south.

quote.zh-CN: 汴京的陷落，把宋的重心永远推向了江南。
quote.en-US: Kaifeng's fall permanently shifted Song to the south.

summary.zh-CN: 玛雅文明城邦奇琴伊察进入全盛时期
summary.en-US: The Maya city-state of Chichen Itza entered its classic flourishing period.

body.zh-CN: 玛雅文明城邦奇琴伊察进入全盛时期
body.en-US: Chichen Itza blended Maya and Toltec influences in its architecture, including the pyramid of Kukulkan. The site became a major political and ceremonial center in the northern Yucatan.

sources: Diego de Landa, Relacion de las cosas de Yucatan

quote.zh-CN: 奇琴伊察金字塔指向太阳，玛雅文明在中美洲写下最后辉煌。
quote.en-US: Chichen Itza's pyramids pointed to the sun—Maya civilization wrote its late brilliance.

title.en-US: Founding of the University of Oxford

summary.zh-CN: 牛津教学活动在12世纪已有记载，1168年为文献中较常被引用的年份之一，严格“建校”年代仍有争议。
summary.en-US: Teaching at Oxford is attested from the 12th century; 1168 is one commonly cited date, though exact foundation remains debated.

body.zh-CN: 牛津教学活动在12世纪已有记载，1168年为文献中较常被引用的年份之一，严格“建校”年代仍有争议。
body.en-US: Oxford developed from scattered scholastic communities into a recognized university by the 13th century. Its early growth reflected the medieval expansion of clerical education in England.

sources: Gerald of Wales, Description of Wales

quote.zh-CN: 牛津的讲堂与学院，中世纪欧洲大学传统的起点之一。
quote.en-US: Oxford's halls and colleges—among the origins of medieval European universities.

title.zh-CN: 平氏灭亡·镰仓幕府建立
title.en-US: Fall of the Taira · Kamakura Shogunate Founded

summary.zh-CN: 坛之浦海战平氏覆灭，源赖朝建立镰仓幕府，日本进入幕府时代
summary.en-US: The Taira were destroyed at Dan-no-ura; Minamoto no Yoritomo established the Kamakura shogunate, opening Japan's feudal era.

body.zh-CN: 坛之浦海战平氏覆灭，源赖朝建立镰仓幕府，日本进入幕府时代
body.en-US: After victory at Dan-no-ura in 1185, Yoritomo consolidated warrior government at Kamakura. The shogunate shifted real power from court nobles to regional samurai lords.

quote.zh-CN: 坛之浦海战，源氏胜而镰仓幕府开启。
quote.en-US: At Dan-no-ura, the Minamoto won—and the Kamakura shogunate began.

title.zh-CN: 第四次十字军洗劫君士坦丁堡

summary.zh-CN: 十字军转而攻陷君士坦丁堡，拉丁帝国建立，拜占庭元气大伤。
summary.en-US: Crusaders sacked Constantinople and established the Latin Empire.

body.zh-CN: 十字军转而攻陷君士坦丁堡，拉丁帝国建立，拜占庭元气大伤。
body.en-US: Crusaders sacked Constantinople and established the Latin Empire.

quote.zh-CN: 本应东征圣地的军队，却将矛头指向了基督教兄弟的城市。
quote.en-US: An army meant for the Holy Land turned its swords on a Christian city.

alt.zh-CN: 君士坦丁堡陷落相关历史画

title.zh-CN: 成吉思汗建立蒙古帝国
title.en-US: Genghis Khan Founds the Mongol Empire

summary.zh-CN: 铁木真在斡难河召开库里尔台，被推举为“成吉思汗”，蒙古帝国建立。
summary.en-US: Temüjin was proclaimed Genghis Khan, uniting the Mongol tribes.

body.zh-CN: 铁木真在斡难河召开库里尔台，被推举为“成吉思汗”，蒙古帝国建立。
body.en-US: In 1206, Temüjin was elevated as Genghis Khan at a kurultai on the Mongolian steppe. The Mongol Empire that followed became the largest contiguous land empire in history.

sources: The Secret History of the Mongols
events.review_note: 文明归属由 china 改为 central_asia

quote.zh-CN: 斡难河畔的库里尔台，草原帝国正式登上世界舞台。
quote.en-US: At the kurultai on the Onon, a steppe empire entered world history.

text.zh-CN: 长生天保佑，我已使蒙古诸部归于一处——谁敢违命？
text.en-US: Eternal Heaven has granted that I unite the Mongol tribes—who dare disobey?

speaker.en-US: The Secret History of the Mongols (paraphrase)

source.en-US: The Secret History of the Mongols

text.zh-CN: 斡难河畔的牧人把毡帐迁到更靠近汗帐的地方，孩子学着在马上射兔。
text.en-US: Herders on the Onon moved their yurts closer to the khan's camp; children practiced shooting hares from horseback.

label.zh-CN: 蒙古帝国分裂后，忽必烈以「元」的名义统治中国
label.en-US: After fragmentation, Kublai ruled China under the name Yuan

summary.zh-CN: 英王约翰在兰尼米德签署《大宪章》，限制王权
summary.en-US: King John sealed Magna Carta at Runnymede in 1215, limiting royal power.

body.zh-CN: 英王约翰在兰尼米德签署《大宪章》，限制王权
body.en-US: Forced by rebellious barons, John accepted a charter of liberties. Later reinterpretations made Magna Carta a symbol of constitutional constraint.

quote.zh-CN: 兰尼米德的大宪章，王权第一次被写进契约。
quote.en-US: At Runnymede, royal power was bound for the first time by charter.

summary.zh-CN: 成吉思汗西征攻灭花剌子模，中亚文明遭受重创。
summary.en-US: Genghis Khan destroyed Khwarezm in the western campaign, devastating Central Asia.

body.zh-CN: 成吉思汗西征攻灭花剌子模，中亚文明遭受重创。
body.en-US: Genghis Khan destroyed Khwarezm in the western campaign, devastating Central Asia.

quote.zh-CN: 撒马尔罕的陷落，是中亚千年文明遭遇的浩劫。
quote.en-US: Samarkand's fall was a catastrophe for Central Asian civilization.

title.en-US: Batu Khan Establishes the Golden Horde

summary.zh-CN: 蒙古拔都汗在伏尔加河流域建立金帐汗国，控制东欧大片草原。
summary.en-US: Batu Khan founded the Golden Horde, ruling the Volga steppe and much of Eastern Europe.

body.zh-CN: 蒙古拔都汗在伏尔加河流域建立金帐汗国，控制东欧大片草原。
body.en-US: Batu Khan founded the Golden Horde, ruling the Volga steppe and much of Eastern Europe.

quote.zh-CN: 蒙古帝国的西翼在伏尔加河畔扎下根来。
quote.en-US: The western wing of the Mongol world took root on the Volga.

summary.zh-CN: 旭烈兀率蒙古大军攻陷巴格达，阿拔斯王朝灭亡
summary.en-US: Hülegü's Mongol army took Baghdad in 1258, ending the Abbasid caliphate there.

body.zh-CN: 旭烈兀率蒙古大军攻陷巴格达，阿拔斯王朝灭亡
body.en-US: The fall of Baghdad devastated a major Islamic capital. It marks a watershed in Middle Eastern political and cultural history.

quote.zh-CN: 底格里斯河上的烟霾，阿拔斯王朝的千年荣光化为灰烬。
quote.en-US: Smoke over the Tigris—the Abbasid caliphate’s glory turned to ash.

summary.zh-CN: 马穆鲁克苏丹国在艾因贾鲁特击败蒙古军，阻止蒙古西进。
summary.en-US: Mamluks defeated the Mongols at Ain Jalut, halting Mongol expansion westward.

body.zh-CN: 马穆鲁克苏丹国在艾因贾鲁特击败蒙古军，阻止蒙古西进。
body.en-US: Mamluks defeated the Mongols at Ain Jalut, halting Mongol expansion westward.

quote.zh-CN: 蒙古无敌神话在此被打破，马穆鲁克拯救了伊斯兰世界。
quote.en-US: Mongol invincibility broke here—the Mamluks saved the Islamic world.

title.en-US: Kublai Khan Proclaims the Yuan Dynasty

summary.zh-CN: 忽必烈采纳汉制，改国号'大元'，定都大都（今北京）
summary.en-US: Kublai Khan adopted the dynastic name Yuan, consolidating Mongol rule in China.

body.zh-CN: 忽必烈采纳汉制，改国号'大元'，定都大都（今北京）
body.en-US: In 1271, Kublai Khan proclaimed the Yuan dynasty. His court linked China more tightly into Eurasian exchange networks spanning the Mongol world.

quote.zh-CN: 大元国号颁行，蒙古与汉地制度在此交汇。
quote.en-US: The Great Yuan proclamation—where Mongol rule met Chinese institutions.

text.zh-CN: 大都的宫城升起新旗，「大元」二字意味着草原汗国与中原王朝合二为一。
text.en-US: New banners rose over Dadu's palace—the name 'Great Yuan' meant steppe khanate and Chinese empire fused as one.

text.zh-CN: 大都街头的波斯匠人为蒙古贵族修理金银器皿，汉语与蒙古语在集市里交错。
text.en-US: Persian artisans in Dadu repaired gold and silver for Mongol nobles; Chinese and Mongol mixed in the bazaar.

label.zh-CN: 成吉思汗统一蒙古，为跨欧亚帝国奠基
label.en-US: Genghis Khan's unification laid foundations for a trans-Eurasian empire

label.zh-CN: 元末民变与红巾军起，最终由朱元璋建立明朝
label.en-US: Yuan decline and Red Turban revolts led to Zhu Yuanzhang's Ming dynasty

summary.zh-CN: 威尼斯商人马可·波罗抵达忽必烈汗的大都，后著《马可·波罗游记》。
summary.en-US: Marco Polo reached Kublai Khan's capital; his Travels later shaped European views of Asia.

body.zh-CN: 威尼斯商人马可·波罗抵达忽必烈汗的大都，后著《马可·波罗游记》。
body.en-US: Marco Polo reached Kublai Khan's capital; his Travels later shaped European views of Asia.

quote.zh-CN: 一部游记，在欧洲人心中打开了东方的想象。
quote.en-US: One travelogue opened the European imagination to the East.

title.en-US: Battle of Yamen · Fall of Southern Song

summary.zh-CN: 元军与南宋在崖山决战，南宋覆灭，元朝统一中国
summary.en-US: Yuan forces destroyed the Song navy at Yamen in 1279, completing Mongol unification of China.

body.zh-CN: 元军与南宋在崖山决战，南宋覆灭，元朝统一中国
body.en-US: The naval defeat at Yamen ended Southern Song resistance. Yuan rule thereafter encompassed most of China proper.

quote.zh-CN: 崖山海战，陆秀夫负帝蹈海，南宋最后的抵抗落幕。
quote.en-US: At Yamen, the Song’s last stand ended— an emperor carried into the sea.

summary.zh-CN: 奥斯曼一世宣布独立，奥斯曼帝国基业奠定
summary.en-US: Osman I declared independence, laying the foundations of the Ottoman state.

body.zh-CN: 奥斯曼一世宣布独立，奥斯曼帝国基业奠定
body.en-US: Osman Bey's small frontier principality in Anatolia grew through raids and alliances against Byzantium. His dynasty eventually expanded into a transcontinental empire spanning three continents.

quote.zh-CN: 奥斯曼帝国奠基，小亚细亚的突厥 Beylik 走向帝国。
quote.en-US: The Ottoman foundation—a Anatolian beylik marched toward empire.

summary.zh-CN: 马里帝国曼萨·穆萨赴麦加朝觐，巨额黄金施舍震惊地中海世界。
summary.en-US: Mansa Musa of Mali made a lavish pilgrimage to Mecca, astonishing the Mediterranean world.

body.zh-CN: 马里帝国曼萨·穆萨赴麦加朝觐，巨额黄金施舍震惊地中海世界。
body.en-US: Mansa Musa of Mali made a lavish pilgrimage to Mecca, astonishing the Mediterranean world.

quote.zh-CN: 一位非洲君主用黄金把马里帝国的名字写进世界地图。
quote.en-US: An African king wrote Mali onto the world map with gold.

alt.zh-CN: 加泰罗尼亚地图集中的曼萨·穆萨
alt.en-US: Mansa Musa in the Catalan Atlas

summary.zh-CN: 阿兹特克人在特斯科科湖中岛建成特诺奇蒂特兰，今墨西哥城前身
summary.en-US: The Aztecs built Tenochtitlan on an island in Lake Texcoco, precursor to modern Mexico City.

body.zh-CN: 阿兹特克人在特斯科科湖中岛建成特诺奇蒂特兰，今墨西哥城前身
body.en-US: According to Mexica tradition, the founding of Tenochtitlan in 1325 fulfilled an omen of an eagle on a cactus. The city grew into a lake-based metropolis and capital of the Aztec empire.

sources: Bernal Díaz del Castillo, True History of the Conquest

quote.zh-CN: 特诺奇蒂特兰在湖心建城，阿兹特克文明达到巅峰。
quote.en-US: Tenochtitlan rose on the lake—Aztec civilization reached its peak.

alt.zh-CN: 特诺奇蒂特兰大神庙遗址

summary.zh-CN: 英格兰与法国之间百年战争拉开序幕
summary.en-US: England and France opened a dynastic and territorial conflict that would last over a century.

body.zh-CN: 英格兰与法国之间百年战争拉开序幕
body.en-US: Edward III's claim to the French throne and disputes over Aquitaine sparked war in 1337. The struggle reshaped national identities, military technology, and the balance of power in late medieval Europe.

sources: Jean Froissart on the Hundred Years' War

quote.zh-CN: 爱德华三世宣称法国王位，英法百年恩怨由此开场。
quote.en-US: Edward III claimed France—the Hundred Years’ War began.

summary.zh-CN: 英格兰长弓手在克雷西战役中大败法国骑士
summary.en-US: English longbowmen routed French knights at Crécy during the Hundred Years' War.

body.zh-CN: 英格兰长弓手在克雷西战役中大败法国骑士
body.en-US: In 1346 Edward III's army used disciplined longbow fire to break repeated French cavalry charges. Crécy demonstrated the rising effectiveness of infantry missile troops against armored nobility.

sources: Jean Froissart, Battle of Crécy account

quote.zh-CN: 克雷西战役，英格兰长弓手改写中世纪战争规则。
quote.en-US: At Crécy, English longbows rewrote the rules of medieval war.

summary.zh-CN: 瘟疫经贸易路线传入欧洲，造成人口锐减，社会结构巨变。
summary.en-US: Plague entered Europe via trade routes, killing millions and reshaping society.

body.zh-CN: 瘟疫经贸易路线传入欧洲，造成人口锐减，社会结构巨变。
body.en-US: Plague entered Europe via trade routes, killing millions and reshaping society.

quote.zh-CN: 三分之一欧洲人死于瘟疫，中世纪的秩序从此动摇。
quote.en-US: A third of Europeans died—medieval order shook to its core.

summary.zh-CN: 朱元璋称帝，建立明朝，推翻元朝统治
summary.en-US: Zhu Yuanzhang drove out the Yuan and established the Ming dynasty.

body.zh-CN: 朱元璋称帝，建立明朝，推翻元朝统治
body.en-US: In 1368, Zhu Yuanzhang (Hongwu Emperor) founded the Ming dynasty and captured Dadu. Ming China restored Han Chinese imperial rule and later sponsored major maritime expeditions.

quote.zh-CN: 洪武元年，朱元璋在应天称帝，明朝开启。
quote.en-US: In the first year of Hongwu, Zhu Yuanzhang proclaimed the Ming dynasty.

text.zh-CN: 应天府的钟鼓齐鸣，「洪武」年号意味着胡元已去，汉家衣冠重回庙堂。
text.en-US: Bells and drums sounded in Yingtian— the Hongwu reign meant the Mongol Yuan was gone and Han imperial rites returned.

text.zh-CN: 江南农户领到「黄册」，第一次被正式编入里甲户籍。
text.en-US: Jiangnan farmers received household registers—they were formally enrolled in lijia taxation for the first time.

label.zh-CN: 元朝统治失序与民族矛盾，激化红巾军等起义
label.en-US: Yuan misrule and ethnic tensions fueled Red Turban and other uprisings

label.zh-CN: 国力强盛后，永乐朝派郑和率宝船下西洋
label.en-US: Ming strength under Yongle enabled Zheng He's treasure fleets

summary.zh-CN: 满者伯夷控制印尼群岛大部，成为东南亚重要海上贸易帝国。
summary.en-US: Majapahit dominated much of the Indonesian archipelago as a maritime empire.

body.zh-CN: 满者伯夷控制印尼群岛大部，成为东南亚重要海上贸易帝国。
body.en-US: Majapahit dominated much of the Indonesian archipelago as a maritime empire.

quote.zh-CN: 香料群岛上的帝国，扼守印度洋与太平洋的航路。
quote.en-US: An empire on the Spice Islands straddled Indian and Pacific sea routes.

alt.zh-CN: 婆罗浮屠（东南亚佛教建筑）

summary.zh-CN: 帖木儿在安卡拉击败奥斯曼巴耶济德一世，奥斯曼帝国陷入危机。
summary.en-US: Timur defeated Bayezid I at Ankara, plunging the Ottoman Empire into crisis.

body.zh-CN: 帖木儿在安卡拉击败奥斯曼巴耶济德一世，奥斯曼帝国陷入危机。
body.en-US: Timur defeated Bayezid I at Ankara, plunging the Ottoman Empire into crisis.

quote.zh-CN: 中亚霸主与奥斯曼苏丹的碰撞，改写了小亚细亚的命运。
quote.en-US: A Central Asian conqueror and an Ottoman sultan collided—Anatolia's fate shifted.

summary.zh-CN: 郑和率船队从南京龙江宝船厂出发，开启第一次下西洋。坐标为出发地南京。
summary.en-US: Zheng He sailed from Nanjing in 1405 on the first of the Ming treasure voyages.

body.zh-CN: 郑和率船队从南京龙江宝船厂出发，开启第一次下西洋。坐标为出发地南京。
body.en-US: Commanding a vast fleet, Zheng He projected Ming maritime power across Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean. The voyages remain icons of early modern Chinese seafaring.

events.review_note: 坐标由新加坡附近修正为南京出发港

quote.zh-CN: 宝船出龙江，郑和第一次把明朝的帆影投向印度洋。
quote.en-US: Treasure ships left Longjiang—Zheng He’s first voyage toward the Indian Ocean.

text.zh-CN: 宝船已集于龙江，即日当扬帆——愿顺风达于诸番。
text.en-US: The treasure ships are assembled at Longjiang—we sail today, may fair winds carry us to foreign lands.

source.en-US: History of Ming — Biography of Zheng He

text.zh-CN: 南京龙江关的纤夫在江岸系缆，南洋来的番商远远张望巨大的宝船桅杆。
text.en-US: Boatmen at Longjiang tied ropes along the shore; merchants from the South Seas stared at the towering masts.

label.zh-CN: 明初国力强盛、永乐雄心，才有大规模远洋航行
label.en-US: Early Ming power and Yongle's ambition made massive voyages possible

label.zh-CN: 与同期欧洲大航海形成东西方平行探索世界海洋的浪潮
label.en-US: Paralleled Europe's age of exploration as both ends of Eurasia took to the oceans

summary.zh-CN: 帕查库蒂开始扩张，印加帝国在安第斯山脉迅速崛起。
summary.en-US: Pachacuti began expansion and the Inca Empire rose rapidly in the Andes.

body.zh-CN: 帕查库蒂开始扩张，印加帝国在安第斯山脉迅速崛起。

quote.zh-CN: 安第斯高原上，印加以石砌工程编织帝国。
