body.zh-CN: 奥斯曼帝国攻占君士坦丁堡，东罗马帝国灭亡
body.en-US: Mehmed II took the city after a decisive siege. Constantinople became Istanbul, capital of an expanding Ottoman imperial order.

quote.zh-CN: 君士坦丁堡的城墙陷落，中世纪的地缘重心东移。
quote.en-US: Constantinople’s walls fell—the geopolitical center of the medieval world shifted.

summary.zh-CN: 约翰内斯·谷登堡使用活字印刷术印制《圣经》，欧洲印刷术开端
summary.en-US: Johannes Gutenberg printed the Bible with movable type in Europe.

body.zh-CN: 约翰内斯·谷登堡使用活字印刷术印制《圣经》，欧洲印刷术开端
body.en-US: Around 1455 in Mainz, Gutenberg's press produced the 42-line Bible. Movable-type printing accelerated the spread of texts, literacy, and Reformation debates across Europe.

sources: 大英图书馆谷登堡圣经说明

image.credit: Wikimedia Commons / New York Public Library

quote.zh-CN: 活字印刷《圣经》，知识传播的速度从此改变。
quote.en-US: Printing the Bible with movable type—knowledge would spread at a new speed.

text.zh-CN: 美因茨作坊里，墨香与木屑混杂——一页页圣经从活字间流出，像打开了知识的水闸。
text.en-US: In Mainz workshops, ink and wood shavings mingled—Bible pages flowed from movable type like a sluice of knowledge opened.

text.zh-CN: 修道院的抄写员第一次摸到印刷本，发现自己的手抄本或许即将过时。
text.en-US: A monastery scribe touched a printed page for the first time, sensing his hand-copied books might soon be obsolete.

label.zh-CN: 君士坦丁堡陷落后，知识与人向东欧扩散，间接推动印刷需求
label.en-US: After Constantinople's fall, knowledge spread westward, indirectly fueling demand for printed texts

label.zh-CN: 印刷术使路德论纲迅速传遍欧洲，宗教改革获得传播利器
label.en-US: Printing spread Luther's theses rapidly—the Reformation gained a mass medium

summary.zh-CN: 哥伦布抵达巴哈马群岛，开启大航海时代与全球联系的新篇章
summary.en-US: Christopher Columbus made landfall in the Caribbean, opening sustained contact across the Atlantic.

body.zh-CN: 哥伦布抵达巴哈马群岛，开启大航海时代与全球联系的新篇章
body.en-US: In 1492, Columbus landed in the Caribbean under the Castilian crown. The voyage inaugurated lasting Atlantic exchange—and profound demographic and political upheaval for Indigenous societies.

quote.zh-CN: 圣萨尔瓦多岛的登陆，旧大陆与新大陆正式相遇。
quote.en-US: Landfall at San Salvador—the Old World and the New formally met.

text.zh-CN: 为感谢上帝使我们到达印度之地……此处必有大陆，可去圣城耶路撒冷。
text.en-US: To give thanks to God for bringing us to the Indies... there must be a mainland from which one could go to the Holy City.

text.zh-CN: 瓜纳哈尼岛的泰诺人从未见过这样的巨船与铁器，好奇与警惕同时写在脸上。
text.en-US: Taíno people on Guanahaní had never seen such ships or iron—their faces mixed curiosity and fear.

label.zh-CN: 东地中海商路受阻，欧洲转向大西洋寻找新航线
label.en-US: Eastern Mediterranean trade faltered; Europe looked west across the Atlantic

label.zh-CN: 跨大西洋联系永久建立，美洲殖民与独立运动由此发端
label.en-US: Permanent Atlantic contact began, leading to colonization and later independence movements

summary.zh-CN: 葡萄牙航海家达·伽马到达印度卡利卡特，开通欧亚新航线
summary.en-US: Da Gama arrived at Calicut in 1498, opening a direct sea route from Europe to India.

body.zh-CN: 葡萄牙航海家达·伽马到达印度卡利卡特，开通欧亚新航线
body.en-US: The Portuguese voyage linked the Atlantic and Indian Ocean worlds. It inaugurated a new phase of European maritime empire in Asia.

sources: Journal of the First Voyage of Vasco da Gama

quote.zh-CN: 达·伽马抵达卡利卡特，欧洲与印度的海上通道被打通。
quote.en-US: Da Gama reached Calicut—a sea route linked Europe and India.

summary.zh-CN: 伊斯玛仪一世建立萨法维王朝，波斯复兴什叶派
summary.en-US: Ismail I established the Safavid dynasty and revived Twelver Shi'ism as state religion in Persia.

body.zh-CN: 伊斯玛仪一世建立萨法维王朝，波斯复兴什叶派
body.en-US: Safavid victory in 1501 reshaped Iran's religious landscape and created a durable rival to Ottoman Sunni power. Isfahan and Tabriz became centers of Shi'i art, trade, and governance.

sources: Iskandar Beg Munshi, Tarikh-i Alam-ara-yi Abbasi

quote.zh-CN: 萨法维王朝建立，波斯再次成为什叶派伊斯兰的中心。
quote.en-US: The Safavid dynasty—Persia became a center of Shia Islam again.

summary.zh-CN: 阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克攻占马六甲，欧洲殖民势力进入东南亚咽喉。
summary.en-US: Albuquerque captured Malacca, opening Southeast Asia to European colonial power.

body.zh-CN: 阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克攻占马六甲，欧洲殖民势力进入东南亚咽喉。
body.en-US: Albuquerque captured Malacca, opening Southeast Asia to European colonial power.

quote.zh-CN: 马六甲的陷落，意味着欧洲舰队扼住了东方航线的咽喉。
quote.en-US: Malacca's fall let European fleets choke the eastern trade routes.

title.zh-CN: 马丁·路德发表《九十五条论纲》

summary.zh-CN: 马丁·路德在维滕贝格发表《九十五条论纲》，宗教改革开启
summary.en-US: Martin Luther challenged indulgences, catalyzing the Protestant Reformation.

body.zh-CN: 马丁·路德在维滕贝格发表《九十五条论纲》，宗教改革开启
body.en-US: In 1517, Martin Luther published his Ninety-five Theses at Wittenberg. The dispute over indulgences and authority grew into the Protestant Reformation, reshaping European religion and politics.

sources: 马丁·路德《九十五条论纲》

alt.en-US: Portrait of Martin Luther by Cranach

quote.zh-CN: 九十五条论纲钉在教堂门上，宗教改革的火种被点燃。
quote.en-US: Ninety-five theses on the church door— the Reformation caught fire.

text.zh-CN: 我叩响教会之门，为真理争辩——赎罪券不应成为买卖灵魂的生意。
text.en-US: I knock at the church door to dispute for truth—indulgences must not be a trade in souls.

text.zh-CN: 维滕贝格的学生把论纲抄本钉在学院公告栏旁，人群中有人开始争论「因信称义」。
text.en-US: Wittenberg students pinned copies beside the faculty board; crowds debated justification by faith.

label.zh-CN: 活字印刷使论纲迅速传播，改革从学术争论变成公共事件
label.en-US: Movable type spread the theses fast—reform leapt from academic dispute to public event

label.zh-CN: 宗教改革冲击旧秩序，为启蒙与革命埋下思想伏笔
label.en-US: The Reformation shook old order, preparing ground for Enlightenment and revolution

summary.zh-CN: 麦哲伦船队从西班牙出发，首次完成环球航行（麦哲伦本人途中阵亡）。
summary.en-US: Magellan's fleet departed Spain on the first circumnavigation (Magellan died en route).

body.zh-CN: 麦哲伦船队从西班牙出发，首次完成环球航行（麦哲伦本人途中阵亡）。
body.en-US: Magellan's fleet departed Spain on the first circumnavigation (Magellan died en route).

quote.zh-CN: 人类第一次用帆船证明：地球是圆的。
quote.en-US: For the first time, ships proved the Earth was round.

summary.zh-CN: 巴布尔在帕尼帕特战役中击败德里苏丹国，莫卧儿帝国建立
summary.en-US: Babur defeated the Delhi Sultanate at Panipat and founded the Mughal Empire.

body.zh-CN: 巴布尔在帕尼帕特战役中击败德里苏丹国，莫卧儿帝国建立
body.en-US: Babur's victory at Panipat in 1526 combined Central Asian cavalry tactics with gunpowder artillery. The Mughal state later unified much of the subcontinent under Akbar, Jahangir, Shah Jahan, and Aurangzeb.

quote.zh-CN: 帕尼帕特之战，莫卧儿帝国在南亚建立统治。
quote.en-US: At Panipat, the Mughal Empire established rule over South Asia.

alt.zh-CN: 泰姬陵（莫卧儿时代建筑）

summary.zh-CN: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗俘获并杀害印加皇帝阿塔瓦尔帕，印加帝国覆灭。
summary.en-US: Francisco Pizarro captured and executed Atahualpa, ending the Inca Empire.

body.zh-CN: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗俘获并杀害印加皇帝阿塔瓦尔帕，印加帝国覆灭。
body.en-US: Francisco Pizarro captured and executed Atahualpa, ending the Inca Empire.

quote.zh-CN: 钢与马匹，在卡哈马卡终结了印加帝国。
quote.en-US: Steel and horses ended the Inca Empire at Cajamarca.

title.zh-CN: 哥白尼发表《天体运行论》

summary.zh-CN: 哥白尼《天体运行论》出版，提出日心说，近代科学革命开端
summary.en-US: Copernicus's heliocentric treatise appeared in 1543, a landmark of the Scientific Revolution.

body.zh-CN: 哥白尼《天体运行论》出版，提出日心说，近代科学革命开端
body.en-US: De Revolutionibus proposed that Earth orbits the Sun. The work challenged geocentric cosmology and reshaped early modern astronomy.

quote.zh-CN: 日心说出版，人类宇宙观从此不再以地球为中心。
quote.en-US: De revolutionibus—humanity’s cosmos ceased to revolve around Earth.

summary.zh-CN: 张居正入阁主政并推行“一条鞭法”等改革。1572年为其任内阁首辅的重要年份，改革延续至万历初年。
summary.en-US: Zhang Juzheng became chief grand secretary and launched reforms including the single-whip method; 1572 marks his rise, with reforms continuing into the Wanli era.

body.zh-CN: 张居正入阁主政并推行“一条鞭法”等改革。1572年为其任内阁首辅的重要年份，改革延续至万历初年。
body.en-US: Zhang Juzheng tightened fiscal administration, improved the Yellow River works, and consolidated authority behind the young Wanli emperor. His death in 1582 led to partial reversal of his policies.

quote.zh-CN: 张居正主政，一条鞭法试图为明王朝续命。
quote.en-US: Zhang Juzheng governed—the single-whip reform tried to renew the Ming.

summary.zh-CN: 英国东印度公司成立，开启英国在亚洲的殖民扩张
summary.en-US: The English East India Company was chartered, beginning Britain's corporate expansion in Asia.

body.zh-CN: 英国东印度公司成立，开启英国在亚洲的殖民扩张
body.en-US: Elizabeth I granted the company a monopoly on English trade east of the Cape. What began as a commercial venture evolved into territorial rule that reshaped South and Southeast Asia.

quote.zh-CN: 东印度公司特许状签署，殖民贸易帝国时代开启。
quote.en-US: The East India Company charter—an age of colonial trade empires began.

summary.zh-CN: 荷兰联合东印度公司（VOC）成立，开启近代股份制殖民贸易时代。
summary.en-US: The VOC was chartered, pioneering modern joint-stock colonial trade.

body.zh-CN: 荷兰联合东印度公司（VOC）成立，开启近代股份制殖民贸易时代。
body.en-US: The VOC was chartered, pioneering modern joint-stock colonial trade.

quote.zh-CN: 世界上第一家跨国公司，把香料与股份制绑在一起。
quote.en-US: The first multinational company tied spices to joint-stock finance.

summary.zh-CN: 德川家康在江户建立幕府，日本进入江户时代
summary.en-US: Tokugawa Ieyasu established the shogunate at Edo, opening the Edo period.

body.zh-CN: 德川家康在江户建立幕府，日本进入江户时代
body.en-US: After victory at Sekigahara, Ieyasu and his successors ruled from Edo (Tokyo). The Tokugawa system enforced peace, sankin-kōtai attendance, and sakoku restrictions that shaped early modern Japan.

quote.zh-CN: 德川家康定都江户，日本进入长达260年的锁国和平。
quote.en-US: Tokugawa settled in Edo—Japan entered 260 years of controlled peace.

summary.zh-CN: 查理一世与议会派冲突升级，英国内战爆发，国王最终被处决。
summary.en-US: Conflict between Charles I and Parliament erupted into civil war; the king was later executed.

body.zh-CN: 查理一世与议会派冲突升级，英国内战爆发，国王最终被处决。
body.en-US: Conflict between Charles I and Parliament erupted into civil war; the king was later executed.

quote.zh-CN: 国王与议会的对决，把英国推向共和国实验。
quote.en-US: King versus Parliament pushed Britain toward republican experiment.

alt.en-US: Battle of Naseby, English Civil War

summary.zh-CN: 清军攻入山海关，李自成败退，清朝定都北京
summary.en-US: Qing armies entered China proper through Shanhai Pass amid Ming collapse.

body.zh-CN: 清军攻入山海关，李自成败退，清朝定都北京
body.en-US: In 1644, as the Ming dynasty collapsed, Qing forces advanced through Shanhai Pass with Ming general Wu Sangui's cooperation. Beijing fell, and Qing rule over China gradually consolidated.

quote.zh-CN: 清军入关，中国最后一个封建王朝定鼎北京。
quote.en-US: The Qing entered the pass—China’s last imperial dynasty settled in Beijing.

text.zh-CN: 山海关的城门在炮声中洞开，关内的百姓还不知道，即将改换的是整个天下的年号。
text.en-US: Shanhai Pass gates burst open under cannon fire—inside, people did not yet know the realm's reign title would change.

text.zh-CN: 北京城的剃发令尚未下达，但胡同里已有人悄悄议论「大清」二字。
text.en-US: The queue order had not yet reached Beijing, but alleys already whispered the name 'Great Qing'.

label.zh-CN: 明后期财政与辽东军情恶化，为清军入关创造条件
label.en-US: Late Ming fiscal crisis and Liaodong wars opened the door for Qing entry

label.zh-CN: 清朝统治危机积累，最终在辛亥革命中帝制终结
label.en-US: Qing crises accumulated until the 1911 Revolution ended imperial rule

summary.zh-CN: 三十年战争结束，威斯特伐利亚和约确立近代民族国家体系与国际法雏形。
summary.en-US: The Peace of Westphalia ended the Thirty Years' War and shaped the modern state system.

body.zh-CN: 三十年战争结束，威斯特伐利亚和约确立近代民族国家体系与国际法雏形。
body.en-US: The Peace of Westphalia ended the Thirty Years' War and shaped the modern state system.

quote.zh-CN: 和约签字，主权国家平等的原则进入近代国际秩序。
quote.en-US: Treaties signed—sovereign equality entered modern international order.

summary.zh-CN: 郑成功驱逐荷兰殖民者，收复台湾，建立明郑政权。
summary.en-US: Koxinga expelled the Dutch and recovered Taiwan, establishing the Kingdom of Tungning.

body.zh-CN: 郑成功驱逐荷兰殖民者，收复台湾，建立明郑政权。
body.en-US: Koxinga expelled the Dutch and recovered Taiwan, establishing the Kingdom of Tungning.

quote.zh-CN: 从荷兰殖民者手中收复台湾，是明清交替的海上篇章。
quote.en-US: Recovering Taiwan from the Dutch marked the maritime chapter of Ming–Qing transition.

summary.zh-CN: 波兰国王索别斯基率军解围维也纳，阻止奥斯曼帝国进一步西进。
summary.en-US: Sobieski relieved Vienna, halting Ottoman expansion into Central Europe.

body.zh-CN: 波兰国王索别斯基率军解围维也纳，阻止奥斯曼帝国进一步西进。
body.en-US: Sobieski relieved Vienna, halting Ottoman expansion into Central Europe.

quote.zh-CN: 维也纳城下的胜利，被视为欧洲与奥斯曼较量的转折点。
quote.en-US: Victory at Vienna marked a turning point between Europe and the Ottoman Empire.

summary.zh-CN: 英国光荣革命，议会权力确立，君主立宪制奠定
summary.en-US: The 1688 Glorious Revolution entrenched parliamentary power and constitutional monarchy in England.

body.zh-CN: 英国光荣革命，议会权力确立，君主立宪制奠定
body.en-US: James II was replaced by William and Mary under conditions that strengthened Parliament. The settlement became a reference point for later liberal constitutionalism.

quote.zh-CN: 光荣革命不流血的政变，议会主权在英国扎根。
quote.en-US: A bloodless revolution—parliamentary sovereignty took root in Britain.

title.zh-CN: 大不列颠联合王国成立

summary.zh-CN: 英格兰与苏格兰合并，大不列颠联合王国正式诞生。
summary.en-US: England and Scotland united to form the Kingdom of Great Britain.

body.zh-CN: 英格兰与苏格兰合并，大不列颠联合王国正式诞生。
body.en-US: England and Scotland united to form the Kingdom of Great Britain.

quote.zh-CN: 岛国政治实体合并，为大英帝国的全球扩张奠基。
quote.en-US: Two kingdoms merged—laying foundations for Britain's global empire.

summary.zh-CN: 《巴黎和约》签署，七年战争结束，英法殖民势力在北美与印度重新划分。
summary.en-US: The Treaty of Paris ended the Seven Years' War, reshaping colonial power in North America and India.

body.zh-CN: 《巴黎和约》签署，七年战争结束，英法殖民势力在北美与印度重新划分。
body.en-US: The Treaty of Paris ended the Seven Years' War, reshaping colonial power in North America and India.

quote.zh-CN: 一场「世界战争」的和约，重划了全球殖民版图。
quote.en-US: A world war's peace treaty redrew the colonial map.

alt.zh-CN: 七年战争时期北美战场
alt.en-US: North American theater of the Seven Years' War

summary.zh-CN: 北美殖民者将英国茶叶倒入波士顿港，反英情绪激化。
summary.en-US: Colonists dumped British tea in Boston Harbor, intensifying resistance to Britain.

body.zh-CN: 北美殖民者将英国茶叶倒入波士顿港，反英情绪激化。
body.en-US: Colonists dumped British tea in Boston Harbor, intensifying resistance to Britain.

quote.zh-CN: 一箱箱茶叶沉入港口，独立战争的导火索被点燃。
quote.en-US: Crates of tea sank in the harbor—the fuse of independence was lit.

summary.zh-CN: 北美十三州签署《独立宣言》，宣布脱离英国。美利坚合众国正式建国及宪法生效在之后年份。
summary.en-US: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence in Philadelphia.

body.zh-CN: 北美十三州签署《独立宣言》，宣布脱离英国。美利坚合众国正式建国及宪法生效在之后年份。
body.en-US: On 4 July 1776, the Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence. It articulated popular sovereignty and natural rights while launching a revolutionary war against Britain.

quote.zh-CN: 人人生而平等——独立宣言把革命写进近代政治语言。
quote.en-US: All men are created equal—the Declaration wrote revolution into modern politics.

text.zh-CN: 我们认为下列真理是不言而喻的：人人生而平等，造物主赋予他们若干不可剥夺的权利。
text.en-US: We hold these truths to be self-evident, that all men are created equal, endowed by their Creator with certain unalienable Rights.

text.zh-CN: 费城街头，报童叫卖宣言全文，酒馆里的种植园主与工匠争论「自由」到底包括谁。
text.en-US: In Philadelphia, newsboys sold the full text; planters and artisans argued in taverns over who 'liberty' included.

label.zh-CN: 大西洋殖民与贸易体系形成，北美殖民地与宗主国矛盾激化
label.en-US: Atlantic colonial and trade systems intensified North American conflict with Britain

label.zh-CN: 启蒙思想与革命实践相互激荡，法国大革命接踵而来
label.en-US: Enlightenment ideas and revolution crossed the Atlantic—the French Revolution followed

summary.zh-CN: 巴黎人民攻占巴士底狱，法国大革命开启现代政治新纪元
summary.en-US: The Estates-General crisis and popular upheaval launched the French Revolution.

body.zh-CN: 巴黎人民攻占巴士底狱，法国大革命开启现代政治新纪元
body.en-US: In 1789, fiscal crisis, Estates-General politics, and the storming of the Bastille ignited the French Revolution. It transformed European ideas of citizenship, rights, and sovereignty.

sources: 托克维尔《旧制度与大革命》
Tocqueville, The Old Regime and the Revolution

quote.zh-CN: 巴士底狱的倒塌，旧制度的象征在一日间碎裂。
quote.en-US: The Bastille fell— a symbol of the old order shattered in a day.

text.zh-CN: 人民是什么？是大多数。大多数是什么？是沉默的。沉默的，就是受压迫的。
text.en-US: What is the people? The majority. What is the majority? The silent. The silent are the oppressed.

text.zh-CN: 巴黎妇女抱着孩子排队买面包，巴士底狱的方向传来隐约的枪声。
text.en-US: Parisian women queued for bread with children in arms; faint gunfire drifted from the Bastille.

label.zh-CN: 美国独立树立「人民主权」榜样，启蒙思想在法国发酵
label.en-US: American independence modeled popular sovereignty; Enlightenment ideas fermented in France

label.zh-CN: 民族国家与共和观念全球传播，影响19—20世纪各地革命
label.en-US: Nation-state and republican ideas spread globally, shaping revolutions into the 20th century

summary.zh-CN: 法属圣多明各黑人奴隶起义，后建立世界上第一个黑人共和国。
summary.en-US: Enslaved people revolted in Saint-Domingue, later founding the first Black republic.

body.zh-CN: 法属圣多明各黑人奴隶起义，后建立世界上第一个黑人共和国。
body.en-US: Enslaved people revolted in Saint-Domingue, later founding the first Black republic.

quote.zh-CN: 奴隶的起义，震动了整个大西洋奴隶制世界。
quote.en-US: A slave uprising shook the entire Atlantic slave system.

summary.zh-CN: 拿破仑在巴黎圣母院加冕为法兰西皇帝
summary.en-US: Napoleon Bonaparte was crowned Emperor of the French at Notre-Dame in Paris.

body.zh-CN: 拿破仑在巴黎圣母院加冕为法兰西皇帝
body.en-US: On 2 December 1804 Napoleon crowned himself in the presence of Pope Pius VII. The empire codified law, reformed administration, and reshaped European borders until his defeat in 1815.

alt.en-US: Napoleon in His Study by Jacques-Louis David

image.credit: Wikimedia Commons / National Gallery of Art

quote.zh-CN: 巴黎圣母院的加冕，拿破仑把革命果实铸成皇冠。
quote.en-US: Crowned at Notre-Dame, Napoleon forged revolution’s gains into an empire.

summary.zh-CN: 伊达尔戈发出「多洛雷斯呼声」，墨西哥独立战争爆发。
summary.en-US: Hidalgo's Grito de Dolores launched Mexico's war of independence.

body.zh-CN: 伊达尔戈发出「多洛雷斯呼声」，墨西哥独立战争爆发。
body.en-US: Hidalgo's Grito de Dolores launched Mexico's war of independence.

quote.zh-CN: 一声呼声，拉美独立浪潮席卷西班牙殖民帝国。
quote.en-US: One cry set independence waves across Spain's American empire.

summary.zh-CN: 拿破仑战败后欧洲列强在维也纳重划势力范围，建立百年均势格局。
summary.en-US: After Napoleon's defeat, powers redrew Europe at Vienna, creating a century of balance.

body.zh-CN: 拿破仑战败后欧洲列强在维也纳重划势力范围，建立百年均势格局。
body.en-US: After Napoleon's defeat, powers redrew Europe at Vienna, creating a century of balance.

quote.zh-CN: 战胜者围坐一张桌，试图把革命与战争锁进旧秩序。
quote.en-US: Victors at one table tried to lock revolution and war into the old order.

alt.zh-CN: 维也纳会议时代欧洲外交

summary.zh-CN: 佩德罗一世宣布巴西脱离葡萄牙独立，成为拉美最大国家。
summary.en-US: Pedro I declared Brazil independent from Portugal, creating Latin America's largest nation.

body.zh-CN: 佩德罗一世宣布巴西脱离葡萄牙独立，成为拉美最大国家。
body.en-US: Pedro I declared Brazil independent from Portugal, creating Latin America's largest nation.

quote.zh-CN: 拉美唯一以帝国形式独立的殖民地，走了一条独特道路。
quote.en-US: Latin America's only imperial independence followed a unique path.

summary.zh-CN: 中英鸦片战争爆发，中国近代史开端
summary.en-US: The First Opium War opened between Britain and Qing China, marking a turning point in modern Chinese history.

body.zh-CN: 中英鸦片战争爆发，中国近代史开端
body.en-US: Disputes over opium trade and diplomatic protocol led to British naval action in 1839–1842. Qing defeat produced the Treaty of Nanjing and forced opening of treaty ports.

alt.en-US: Signing of the Treaty of Nanking

quote.zh-CN: 鸦片战争的炮声，叩开了中国近代史的大门。
quote.en-US: The guns of the Opium War opened the door to modern Chinese history.

summary.zh-CN: 马克思和恩格斯在伦敦发表《共产党宣言》
summary.en-US: Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels published The Communist Manifesto in London.

body.zh-CN: 马克思和恩格斯在伦敦发表《共产党宣言》
body.en-US: Written amid the revolutions of 1848, the pamphlet argued that class struggle drives history and called for workers to unite. It became one of the most influential political texts of the modern era.

sources: Marx and Engels, Manifesto of the Communist Party

quote.zh-CN: 全世界无产者，联合起来。
quote.en-US: Workers of the world, unite.

summary.zh-CN: 印度士兵与民众起义反抗英国东印度公司统治，后遭残酷镇压。
summary.en-US: Indian soldiers and civilians rebelled against Company rule; Britain crushed the uprising.

body.zh-CN: 印度士兵与民众起义反抗英国东印度公司统治，后遭残酷镇压。
body.en-US: Indian soldiers and civilians rebelled against Company rule; Britain crushed the uprising.

quote.zh-CN: 一场起义，让英国直接接管印度，「王冠上的宝石」进入帝国核心。
quote.en-US: A rebellion brought direct British rule—the jewel entered the imperial crown.

title.en-US: Emancipation of the Serfs in Russia

summary.zh-CN: 亚历山大二世签署废除农奴制法令
summary.en-US: Tsar Alexander II signed the decree abolishing serfdom in the Russian Empire.

body.zh-CN: 亚历山大二世签署废除农奴制法令
body.en-US: The 1861 emancipation freed millions of serfs but imposed redemption payments and communal land arrangements. It was a major step toward modernizing Russia's social and economic order.

quote.zh-CN: 解放法令签署，俄国农奴制走向终结。
quote.en-US: The emancipation decree—Russian serfdom began its end.

summary.zh-CN: 日本明治天皇即位，维新运动全面展开，日本走上近代化道路
summary.en-US: Emperor Meiji took the throne and reformers launched modernization, setting Japan on a path of rapid change.

body.zh-CN: 日本明治天皇即位，维新运动全面展开，日本走上近代化道路
body.en-US: The Meiji Restoration dismantled Tokugawa rule and pursued centralization, conscription, industrialization, and Western-style institutions. Japan emerged as a modern state and regional power within decades.

quote.zh-CN: 明治改元，日本以举国之力奔向近代化。
quote.en-US: The Meiji era began—Japan raced toward modernization as a nation.

summary.zh-CN: 普鲁士击败法国，德意志帝国在凡尔赛宫宣告成立
summary.en-US: Prussia defeated France; the German Empire was proclaimed at Versailles.

body.zh-CN: 普鲁士击败法国，德意志帝国在凡尔赛宫宣告成立
body.en-US: Prussian victory in 1870–1871 led to German unification under Wilhelm I and Bismarck. France lost Alsace-Lorraine and the war reshaped the European balance of power.

quote.zh-CN: 普法战争爆发，德意志统一的最后一块拼图落下。
quote.en-US: The Franco-Prussian War—the final piece of German unification fell into place.

summary.zh-CN: 欧洲列强在柏林会议划分非洲势力范围，「瓜分非洲」加速。
summary.en-US: European powers divided Africa at Berlin, accelerating the Scramble for Africa.

body.zh-CN: 欧洲列强在柏林会议划分非洲势力范围，「瓜分非洲」加速。
body.en-US: European powers divided Africa at Berlin, accelerating the Scramble for Africa.

quote.zh-CN: 一张地图上的线条，决定了非洲未来百年的命运。
quote.en-US: Lines on a map decided Africa's fate for a century.

summary.zh-CN: 埃塞俄比亚在阿杜瓦击败意大利入侵军，维护非洲独立。
summary.en-US: Ethiopia defeated Italy at Adwa, preserving African independence.

body.zh-CN: 埃塞俄比亚在阿杜瓦击败意大利入侵军，维护非洲独立。
body.en-US: Ethiopia defeated Italy at Adwa, preserving African independence.

quote.zh-CN: 非洲国家以战场胜利迫使殖民帝国承认其主权。
quote.en-US: An African state forced a colonial power to recognize its sovereignty on the battlefield.

summary.zh-CN: 光绪帝颁布《明定国是诏》，启动百日维新
summary.en-US: Emperor Guangxu issued the 'Decree on National Renewal,' launching the Hundred Days' Reform.

body.zh-CN: 光绪帝颁布《明定国是诏》，启动百日维新
body.en-US: Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao advised Guangxu to modernize education, administration, and military institutions. Conservative backlash and a coup ended the reforms after about 103 days.

quote.zh-CN: 明定国是诏颁布，百日维新试图为清王朝续命。
quote.en-US: The reform edict of 1898— a hundred days to save the Qing dynasty.

alt.zh-CN: 天安门（戊戌变法时代背景）

title.zh-CN: 莱特兄弟首次动力飞行

summary.zh-CN: 莱特兄弟在北卡罗来纳基蒂霍克完成首次持续动力飞行。
summary.en-US: The Wright brothers achieved sustained powered flight at Kitty Hawk.

body.zh-CN: 莱特兄弟在北卡罗来纳基蒂霍克完成首次持续动力飞行。
body.en-US: The Wright brothers achieved sustained powered flight at Kitty Hawk.

quote.zh-CN: 人类首次离开地面，依靠自己的动力翱翔。
quote.en-US: Humans left the ground under their own power for the first time.

summary.zh-CN: 日本通过《日韩合并条约》正式吞并朝鲜，殖民统治开始。
summary.en-US: Japan annexed Korea through the Japan–Korea Annexation Treaty.

body.zh-CN: 日本通过《日韩合并条约》正式吞并朝鲜，殖民统治开始。
body.en-US: Japan annexed Korea through the Japan–Korea Annexation Treaty.

quote.zh-CN: 一纸条约，朝鲜半岛进入长达35年的殖民时代。
quote.en-US: One treaty began 35 years of colonial rule on the Korean Peninsula.

summary.zh-CN: 武昌起义爆发，辛亥革命推翻清朝，结束中国封建帝制
summary.en-US: The 1911 Revolution overthrew Qing imperial rule and led toward the Republic of China.

body.zh-CN: 武昌起义爆发，辛亥革命推翻清朝，结束中国封建帝制
body.en-US: Beginning with the Wuchang Uprising in October 1911, revolutionary forces ended over two millennia of imperial monarchy in China. Sun Yat-sen became provisional president of the new republic.

quote.zh-CN: 武昌城头一声枪响，两千年的帝制就此终结。
quote.en-US: A shot in Wuchang ended two millennia of imperial rule in China.

text.zh-CN: 革命尚未成功，同志仍须努力。
text.en-US: The revolution is not yet complete; comrades must still strive.

source.zh-CN: 孙中山遗嘱（1925，精神延续至1911）
source.en-US: Sun Yat-sen's Final Will (1925; spirit of 1911)

text.zh-CN: 武昌城头的士兵剪下辫子，城外的铁路工人第一次听说「民国」二字。
text.en-US: Soldiers on Wuchang's walls cut their queues; railway workers outside first heard the word 'Republic'.

label.zh-CN: 清朝统治危机与立宪失败，革命党在各地积蓄力量
label.en-US: Qing crisis and failed constitutional reform let revolutionaries organize nationwide

label.zh-CN: 共和与民族自决观念传入，为反帝反封建提供思想资源
label.en-US: Republican and national self-determination ideas supplied anti-imperial rhetoric

summary.zh-CN: 奥匈帝国向塞尔维亚宣战，一战全面爆发
summary.en-US: Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia, triggering the First World War.

body.zh-CN: 奥匈帝国向塞尔维亚宣战，一战全面爆发
body.en-US: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo set off alliance obligations across Europe. By August 1914 a continent-wide war had begun, drawing in empires from Europe, Africa, and Asia.

sources: Barbara Tuchman, The Guns of August
figures: 萨拉热窝刺客普林西普

alt.zh-CN: 斐迪南大公（一战导火索相关）

quote.zh-CN: 萨拉热窝的枪声之后，欧洲在1914年滑向世界大战。
quote.en-US: After Sarajevo, Europe slid into world war in 1914.

summary.zh-CN: 布尔什维克夺取政权，苏维埃俄国成立，深刻影响20世纪世界格局。
summary.en-US: The Bolsheviks seized power, founding Soviet Russia and reshaping the 20th century.

body.zh-CN: 布尔什维克夺取政权，苏维埃俄国成立，深刻影响20世纪世界格局。
body.en-US: The Bolsheviks seized power, founding Soviet Russia and reshaping the 20th century.

quote.zh-CN: 冬宫的一声炮响，把社会主义实验推上历史前台。
quote.en-US: A shot at the Winter Palace thrust socialism onto history's stage.

summary.zh-CN: 1918年11月11日协约国与德国签署停战协定，一战结束。
summary.en-US: The Armistice of 11 November 1918 ended the First World War.

body.zh-CN: 1918年11月11日协约国与德国签署停战协定，一战结束。
body.en-US: The Armistice of 11 November 1918 ended the First World War.

quote.zh-CN: 十一点十一分，停战钟声在欧洲回荡。
quote.en-US: At the eleventh hour, armistice bells rang across Europe.

summary.zh-CN: 凯末尔领导土耳其民族独立战争胜利，废除苏丹制，建立共和国。
summary.en-US: Atatürk proclaimed the Republic after winning the War of Independence and abolishing the sultanate.

body.zh-CN: 凯末尔领导土耳其民族独立战争胜利，废除苏丹制，建立共和国。
body.en-US: Atatürk proclaimed the Republic after winning the War of Independence and abolishing the sultanate.

quote.zh-CN: 从帝国废墟中，一个世俗化的现代民族国家站起来。
quote.en-US: From imperial ruins rose a secular modern nation-state.

summary.zh-CN: 纽约股市崩盘，引发大萧条，全球经济与社会陷入长期危机。
summary.en-US: The New York stock market crashed, triggering the Great Depression worldwide.

body.zh-CN: 纽约股市崩盘，引发大萧条，全球经济与社会陷入长期危机。
body.en-US: The New York stock market crashed, triggering the Great Depression worldwide.

quote.zh-CN: 黑色星期四，把1920年代的繁荣瞬间蒸发。
quote.en-US: Black Thursday vaporized the prosperity of the 1920s overnight.

summary.zh-CN: 卢沟桥事变后中国全面抗战爆发，第二次世界大战亚洲战场关键组成。
summary.en-US: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, full-scale war in China became a major part of WWII in Asia.

body.zh-CN: 卢沟桥事变后中国全面抗战爆发，第二次世界大战亚洲战场关键组成。
body.en-US: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, full-scale war in China became a major part of WWII in Asia.

quote.zh-CN: 七七事变，中华民族八年抗战的起点。
quote.en-US: The Marco Polo Bridge Incident began China's eight-year war of resistance.

title.zh-CN: 第二次世界大战欧洲战场爆发
title.en-US: World War II Begins in Europe

summary.zh-CN: 纳粹德国入侵波兰，英法对德宣战，二战欧洲战场爆发。
summary.en-US: Germany invaded Poland; Britain and France declared war, opening WWII in Europe.

body.zh-CN: 纳粹德国入侵波兰，英法对德宣战，二战欧洲战场爆发。
body.en-US: Germany invaded Poland; Britain and France declared war, opening WWII in Europe.

quote.zh-CN: 波兰的陷落，把人类再次推入世界大战的深渊。
quote.en-US: Poland's fall plunged humanity into world war again.

summary.zh-CN: 德国、日本先后投降，第二次世界大战结束。此为全球战争，此处标注主要投降仪式所在欧洲战场节点。
summary.en-US: Germany and Japan surrendered, ending the Second World War; this entry marks the European surrender node of a global conflict.

body.zh-CN: 德国、日本先后投降，第二次世界大战结束。此为全球战争，此处标注主要投降仪式所在欧洲战场节点。
body.en-US: Germany surrendered in May 1945 and Japan in September after atomic bombings and Soviet entry into the Pacific war. The conflict reshaped borders, superpower rivalry, and the United Nations order.

events.review_note: 全球事件，文明标注仅作地图着色参考

alt.en-US: Raising the flag over the Reichstag, 1945

quote.zh-CN: 密苏里号上的签字，人类历史上最惨烈的战争终于落幕。
quote.en-US: Signatures on the Missouri—history’s deadliest war finally ended.

summary.zh-CN: 1945年8月15日日本宣布投降，第二次世界大战亚洲战场结束。
summary.en-US: Japan announced surrender on 15 August 1945, ending WWII in Asia.

body.zh-CN: 1945年8月15日日本宣布投降，第二次世界大战亚洲战场结束。
body.en-US: Japan announced surrender on 15 August 1945, ending WWII in Asia.

quote.zh-CN: 亚洲战场的硝烟散去，冷战格局在废墟上酝酿。
quote.en-US: Smoke cleared in Asia—the Cold War gestated in the ruins.

summary.zh-CN: 胡志明领导越南八月革命，宣布独立，建立越南民主共和国。
summary.en-US: Ho Chi Minh led the August Revolution, declaring independence and founding the DRV.

body.zh-CN: 胡志明领导越南八月革命，宣布独立，建立越南民主共和国。
body.en-US: Ho Chi Minh led the August Revolution, declaring independence and founding the DRV.

quote.zh-CN: 「越南独立」的宣言，在殖民废墟上响起。
quote.en-US: A declaration of Vietnamese independence rang from colonial ruins.

summary.zh-CN: 印度脱离英国殖民统治独立，同时印巴分治。
summary.en-US: India gained independence from Britain amid partition with Pakistan.

body.zh-CN: 印度脱离英国殖民统治独立，同时印巴分治。
body.en-US: India gained independence from Britain amid partition with Pakistan.

quote.zh-CN: 非暴力与民族自决，为殖民世界树立独立榜样。
quote.en-US: Nonviolence and self-determination set a model for the colonial world.

summary.zh-CN: 毛泽东在天安门宣告中华人民共和国成立，中国进入新纪元。
summary.en-US: Mao Zedong proclaimed the PRC at Tiananmen, opening a new era for China.

body.zh-CN: 毛泽东在天安门宣告中华人民共和国成立，中国进入新纪元。
body.en-US: Mao Zedong proclaimed the PRC at Tiananmen, opening a new era for China.

quote.zh-CN: 中国人民站起来了。
quote.en-US: The Chinese people have stood up.

summary.zh-CN: 朝鲜战争爆发，冷战时期第一场大规模热战。
summary.en-US: The Korean War began—the Cold War's first major hot conflict.

body.zh-CN: 朝鲜战争爆发，冷战时期第一场大规模热战。
body.en-US: The Korean War began—the Cold War's first major hot conflict.

quote.zh-CN: 三八线两侧的冲突，把冷战推入热战边缘。
quote.en-US: Conflict across the 38th parallel pushed the Cold War toward hot war.

summary.zh-CN: 亚非29国在印度尼西亚万隆召开会议，推动不结盟与第三世界合作。
summary.en-US: Twenty-nine Asian and African states met at Bandung, advancing non-alignment.

body.zh-CN: 亚非29国在印度尼西亚万隆召开会议，推动不结盟与第三世界合作。
body.en-US: Twenty-nine Asian and African states met at Bandung, advancing non-alignment.

quote.zh-CN: 亚非团结的呼声，在冷战两极之间寻找第三条道路。
quote.en-US: Asian-African solidarity sought a third path between Cold War blocs.

summary.zh-CN: 埃及纳赛尔国有化苏伊士运河，引发英法以军事干预，标志殖民时代进一步终结。
summary.en-US: Nasser nationalized the Suez Canal, triggering intervention and marking colonial decline.

body.zh-CN: 埃及纳赛尔国有化苏伊士运河，引发英法以军事干预，标志殖民时代进一步终结。
body.en-US: Nasser nationalized the Suez Canal, triggering intervention and marking colonial decline.

quote.zh-CN: 运河归属之争，是旧殖民秩序与新民族主义碰撞的缩影。
quote.en-US: Canal ownership epitomized colonial order colliding with nationalism.

summary.zh-CN: 加纳脱离英国独立，成为撒哈拉以南非洲第一个独立国家。
summary.en-US: Ghana became the first sub-Saharan African state to gain independence from Britain.

body.zh-CN: 加纳脱离英国独立，成为撒哈拉以南非洲第一个独立国家。
body.en-US: Ghana became the first sub-Saharan African state to gain independence from Britain.

quote.zh-CN: 黑星升起，非洲非殖民化浪潮的号角吹响。
quote.en-US: The Black Star rose—the decolonization wave sounded across Africa.

summary.zh-CN: 尼日利亚脱离英国独立，1960年被称为「非洲独立年」。
summary.en-US: Nigeria gained independence from Britain in the "Year of Africa."

body.zh-CN: 尼日利亚脱离英国独立，1960年被称为「非洲独立年」。
body.en-US: Nigeria gained independence from Britain in the "Year of Africa."

quote.zh-CN: 非洲人口最多的国家独立，非殖民化浪潮达到高潮。
quote.en-US: Africa's most populous nation became independent—decolonization peaked.

summary.zh-CN: 美苏因古巴部署导弹对峙，世界濒临核战争边缘。
summary.en-US: The US and USSR confronted over missiles in Cuba, bringing the world to the nuclear brink.

body.zh-CN: 美苏因古巴部署导弹对峙，世界濒临核战争边缘。
body.en-US: The US and USSR confronted over missiles in Cuba, bringing the world to the nuclear brink.

quote.zh-CN: 十三天对峙，人类离核毁灭最近的一次。
quote.en-US: Thirteen days—humanity's closest brush with nuclear ruin.

alt.zh-CN: 肯尼迪就古巴导弹危机发表讲话
alt.en-US: President Kennedy on the Cuban Missile Crisis

summary.zh-CN: 阿姆斯特朗与奥尔德林登陆月球，人类首次踏上地外天体。
summary.en-US: Armstrong and Aldrin landed on the Moon—the first humans on another world.

body.zh-CN: 阿姆斯特朗与奥尔德林登陆月球，人类首次踏上地外天体。
body.en-US: Armstrong and Aldrin landed on the Moon—the first humans on another world.

quote.zh-CN: 这是个人的一小步，却是人类的一大步。
quote.en-US: One small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.

summary.zh-CN: 1975年4月北越攻占西贡，越南战争结束，越南统一。
summary.en-US: North Vietnam captured Saigon in April 1975, ending the war and unifying Vietnam.

body.zh-CN: 1975年4月北越攻占西贡，越南战争结束，越南统一。
body.en-US: North Vietnam captured Saigon in April 1975, ending the war and unifying Vietnam.

quote.zh-CN: 直升机撤离的照片，成为美国干预东南亚时代的句号。
quote.en-US: Helicopter evacuations punctuated America's era in Southeast Asia.

title.en-US: China's Reform and Opening Up Begins

summary.zh-CN: 十一届三中全会召开，中国开启改革开放历史新时期。
summary.en-US: The Third Plenum launched China's reform and opening-up era.

body.zh-CN: 十一届三中全会召开，中国开启改革开放历史新时期。
body.en-US: The Third Plenum launched China's reform and opening-up era.

quote.zh-CN: 解放思想、实事求是——一个时代的开关被打开。
quote.en-US: Emancipate the mind, seek truth from facts—a new era switched on.

summary.zh-CN: 柏林墙开放，冷战象征崩塌，德国统一进程加速。
summary.en-US: The Berlin Wall opened, a Cold War symbol fell, and German reunification accelerated.

body.zh-CN: 柏林墙开放，冷战象征崩塌，德国统一进程加速。
body.en-US: The Berlin Wall opened, a Cold War symbol fell, and German reunification accelerated.

quote.zh-CN: 一堵墙倒下，冷战的分割线在欧洲中部瓦解。
quote.en-US: A wall fell—and the Cold War's divide crumbled in central Europe.

summary.zh-CN: 苏联正式解体，冷战结束，独联体成立。
summary.en-US: The USSR dissolved, ending the Cold War and forming the CIS.

body.zh-CN: 苏联正式解体，冷战结束，独联体成立。
body.en-US: The USSR dissolved, ending the Cold War and forming the CIS.

quote.zh-CN: 红旗降落，二十世纪地缘政治最重大的变局之一。
quote.en-US: The red flag lowered—one of the twentieth century's greatest geopolitical shifts.

summary.zh-CN: 南非举行首次不分种族的民主选举，曼德拉当选总统，种族隔离制度终结。
summary.en-US: South Africa held its first non-racial elections; Mandela became president and apartheid ended.

body.zh-CN: 南非举行首次不分种族的民主选举，曼德拉当选总统，种族隔离制度终结。
body.en-US: South Africa held its first non-racial elections; Mandela became president and apartheid ended.

quote.zh-CN: 长期囚禁之后的选票，把种族隔离送进历史。
quote.en-US: Ballots after long imprisonment sent apartheid into history.

summary.zh-CN: 1997年7月1日香港主权移交中华人民共和国，「一国两制」实践开始。
summary.en-US: Hong Kong's sovereignty transferred to China on 1 July 1997 under "one country, two systems."

body.zh-CN: 1997年7月1日香港主权移交中华人民共和国，「一国两制」实践开始。
body.en-US: Hong Kong's sovereignty transferred to China on 1 July 1997 under "one country, two systems."

quote.zh-CN: 午夜时分，米字旗降下，156年的殖民时代结束。
quote.en-US: At midnight the Union Jack fell—156 years of colonial rule ended.
